name: AnimatedContent
description: Wrapper that reveals its content on scroll with slides, blur, 3D tilts, soft wipes and staggered children.

table.name: children
table.description: The content to animate.

table.name: container
table.description: Scroll container that drives the animation, as a selector or an element. Defaults to the page.

table.name: distance
table.description: How far the content travels into place, in px.

table.name: direction
table.description: Axis the content travels along.

table.name: reverse
table.description: Comes in from the opposite side: from above, or from the left.

table.name: duration
table.description: Length of the animation, in seconds.

table.name: ease
table.description: Any GSAP ease, such as 'expo.out', 'back.out(1.6)' or 'elastic.out(1, 0.5)'.

table.name: initialOpacity
table.description: Opacity the content starts from.

table.name: animateOpacity
table.description: Fades the content in. Turn off to keep it fully opaque while it moves.

table.name: scale
table.description: Scale the content starts from.

table.name: blur
table.description: Blur the content starts from, in px. It comes into focus as it lands.

table.name: rotate
table.description: Rotation the content starts from, in degrees.

table.name: tilt
table.description: Tips the content back in 3D, in degrees, so it flips up into place.

table.name: wipe
table.description: Reveals the content behind a soft moving edge instead of all at once.

table.name: threshold
table.description: How far into the viewport the top of the content must be before it animates, from 0 to 1.

table.name: delay
table.description: Wait before the animation starts, in seconds.

table.name: stagger
table.description: Animates each direct child in turn, this many seconds apart. Great for lists and grids.

table.name: staggerFrom
table.description: Which child goes first when staggering.

table.name: trigger
table.description: Animate when the content scrolls into view, or right away.

table.name: once
table.description: Plays once. Turn off to replay every time the content scrolls in, and reverse when it scrolls back out.

table.name: scrub
table.description: Ties the animation to the scroll position. A number smooths it, in seconds.

table.name: disappearAfter
table.description: Hides the content again this many seconds after it appears. 0 keeps it shown.

table.name: disappearDuration
table.description: Length of the hide animation, in seconds.

table.name: disappearEase
table.description: GSAP ease of the hide animation.

table.name: onStart
table.description: Called when the animation starts.

table.name: onComplete
table.description: Called when the animation finishes.

table.name: onDisappearanceComplete
table.description: Called when the hide animation finishes.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the wrapper.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the wrapper.

name: BlobCursor
description: Liquid metal blob cursor that stretches, sloshes and bursts into droplets, in chrome, jelly, pearl or ink.

table.name: material
table.description: What the blob is made of. Chrome is liquid metal, jelly a glossy colored gel, pearl an iridescent shell and ink a flat goo.

table.name: color
table.description: Color of the blob. Tints the reflections on chrome and pearl, and fills jelly and ink.

table.name: blend
table.description: How the blob mixes with the page under it. Difference with a white ink blob inverts whatever it covers.

table.name: size
table.description: Diameter of the main blob in pixels.

table.name: morph
table.description: How far the blob drifts from a perfect sphere, from 0 for a round bead to 1 for a restless, shapeshifting puddle.

table.name: morphSpeed
table.description: How fast the shape keeps changing, from 0 for a frozen shape to 1 for a boiling one.

table.name: depth
table.description: How tall the liquid stands, from 0 for a flat puddle to 1 for a full, round bead.

table.name: trail
table.description: How many links the liquid tail has, from 0 for no tail to 16 for a long tail that curves along your path.

table.name: lag
table.description: How lazily the blob follows the pointer, from 0 for tight to 1 for slow and floaty.

table.name: goo
table.description: How thick and syrupy the liquid is where the tail and droplets meet the blob, from 0 for crisp to 1 for gooey.

table.name: stretch
table.description: How far the blob pulls out into a teardrop as it moves, from 0 for short to 1 for a long comet.

table.name: wobble
table.description: How bouncy and jelly-like it is when it stops, turns or gets clicked.

table.name: drip
table.description: How many droplets fling off the tail on fast moves. They stay on the page until they dry up or the blob soaks them back up.

table.name: shine
table.description: Strength of the highlights and reflections.

table.name: splash
table.description: Clicking bursts droplets out of the blob. They fly off the page and the blob grows back.

table.name: splashCount
table.description: How many droplets each click throws out, from 1 to 32.

table.name: splashSpeed
table.description: How fast the droplets fly, from 0 for a gentle spill to 1 for a hard burst.

table.name: splashSize
table.description: Size of the droplets relative to the blob. Bigger droplets take more of the blob with them.

table.name: splashGravity
table.description: Pulls the droplets down as they fly, from 0 for straight lines to 1 for a heavy arc.

table.name: regrow
table.description: How quickly the blob grows back to full size after a splash.

table.name: shadow
table.description: Casts a soft shadow under the blob so it sits on the page.

table.name: hideCursor
table.description: Hides the system cursor over the area so the blob becomes the cursor.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the root element.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the root element.

name: ClickSpark
description: Bursts of sparks at every click, as dashes, comets, dots or stars, that can spill around buttons.

table.name: sparkColor
table.description: Color of the sparks. Pass a list to mix colors through each burst.

table.name: shape
table.description: Look of each spark: a short dash, a comet with a fading tail, a round dot, or a twinkling star.

table.name: sparkCount
table.description: Number of sparks in each burst.

table.name: sparkSize
table.description: Length of each spark, in px.

table.name: sparkWidth
table.description: Thickness of each spark, in px.

table.name: sparkRadius
table.description: How far the sparks travel from the click, in px.

table.name: duration
table.description: Length of a burst, in ms.

table.name: easing
table.description: How the sparks slow down as they fly out. Spring overshoots a little and settles back.

table.name: randomness
table.description: Varies the angle, length and speed of each spark, from 0 to 1. 0 gives a perfect star.

table.name: gravity
table.description: Pulls the sparks down as they fly, from 0 to 2.

table.name: spread
table.description: Angle the sparks fan across, in degrees. 360 is a full circle.

table.name: direction
table.description: Where a partial spread points, in degrees. 0 is up and 90 is right.

table.name: glow
table.description: Soft light around each spark, from 0 to 1.

table.name: ring
table.description: Adds a thin ring that expands from the click.

table.name: layer
table.description: Draws the sparks over your content, or behind it so they burst out around buttons and cards.

table.name: extraScale
table.description: Multiplies how far the sparks travel.

table.name: disabled
table.description: Stops new bursts.

table.name: ref
table.description: Call spark() to fire a burst from code. x and y are in px from the top left; it centers without them.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the wrapper.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the wrapper.

table.name: children
table.description: Content to wrap. Clicks anywhere inside it send sparks, which can spill past its edges.

name: Crosshair
description: Crosshair cursor with live coordinates that locks onto links and buttons and measures them.

table.name: color
table.description: Color of the lines, labels and brackets.

table.name: containerRef
table.description: Keeps the crosshair inside this element, which needs a position other than static. Without it the crosshair covers the whole viewport.

table.name: thickness
table.description: Line thickness in px.

table.name: opacity
table.description: Opacity of everything the crosshair draws.

table.name: lineStyle
table.description: Stroke style of the two lines.

table.name: gap
table.description: Empty space in px left around the pointer where the lines would cross.

table.name: fade
table.description: How much the lines fade out toward the edges, from 0 to 1.

table.name: smoothing
table.description: How far the lines trail behind the pointer. 0 sticks to it.

table.name: showCoordinates
table.description: Shows the pointer position where the lines meet the edges, and the size of a locked target.

table.name: targetEffect
table.description: What happens over a target. Lock frames it with corner brackets and measures it, glitch shakes the lines like a bad signal.

table.name: targetSelector
table.description: CSS selector for the elements the crosshair reacts to.

table.name: clickPulse
table.description: Sends a ring out from the pointer on every click or tap.

table.name: hideCursor
table.description: Hides the system cursor inside the crosshair area and marks the pointer with a dot instead.

table.name: blendMode
table.description: Difference inverts whatever is under the lines, so they stay visible on any background.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the canvas.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the canvas.

name: Cubes
description: A grid of outlined 3D cubes that turn to face the cursor, spin when swept and ripple on click.

table.name: gridSize
table.description: Number of cubes on each side of the grid.

table.name: gap
table.description: Space between cubes, as a fraction of a cell.

table.name: faceColor
table.description: Color of the cube faces. Match it to your page background for a clean cut-out look.

table.name: edgeColor
table.description: Color of the cube outlines.

table.name: edgeWidth
table.description: Width of the outlines in px.

table.name: edgeStyle
table.description: How the cube outlines are drawn.

table.name: faceOpacity
table.description: Opacity of the faces, from 0 for see-through wireframes to 1 for solid cubes.

table.name: shading
table.description: How much the sides of turned cubes pick up light, so they read as solid 3D shapes.

table.name: maxAngle
table.description: How far cubes turn to face the cursor, in degrees.

table.name: radius
table.description: How far the cursor reaches, in cubes.

table.name: speed
table.description: How quickly cubes respond.

table.name: bounce
table.description: How much cubes overshoot and wobble as they settle, from 0 to 1.

table.name: brush
table.description: How strongly fast cursor sweeps spin the cubes they pass over.

table.name: perspective
table.description: Camera perspective, from 0 for a flat front view to 1 for strong depth.

table.name: autoAnimate
table.description: Drifts a gentle wave across the grid while the cursor is away.

table.name: rippleOnClick
table.description: Clicking sends a ripple through the cubes that lights up their edges.

table.name: rippleColor
table.description: Color the ripple lights the cubes with.

table.name: rippleSpeed
table.description: Speed of the ripple.

table.name: intro
table.description: Cubes tumble into place from the center on mount.

table.name: paused
table.description: Freezes the animation.

table.name: dpr
table.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the container.

name: ElectricBorder
description: Wraps any element in crackling strands of current that surge near the cursor and leap off in sparks.

table.name: children
table.description: Content wrapped by the electric border.

table.name: color
table.description: Color of the current. The strands burn whiter at their core.

table.name: glowColor
table.description: Color of the glow around the strands. Defaults to color.

table.name: speed
table.description: How fast the current crackles and moves.

table.name: chaos
table.description: How jagged the strands are, from 0 to 2.

table.name: spread
table.description: How far the strands wander from the edge, from 0 to 2.

table.name: thickness
table.description: Thickness of the strands, in px.

table.name: strands
table.description: Number of strands running along the edge, from 1 to 6.

table.name: glow
table.description: Strength of the glow around the border.

table.name: intensity
table.description: Overall brightness of the current.

table.name: arcs
table.description: How often sparks leap off the border. 0 turns them off.

table.name: flicker
table.description: How much the current flickers, from 0 to 1.

table.name: borderRadius
table.description: Corner radius of the border, in px. Match it to your content.

table.name: offset
table.description: Moves the border outward from the edge of the content, in px. Negative values move it inward.

table.name: active
table.description: Powers the border on or off. Turning it on sends the current racing around the edge again.

table.name: intro
table.description: The current races around the edge from the top when the border mounts.

table.name: interactive
table.description: The current surges near the cursor and clicks send a jolt around the edge.

table.name: cursorRadius
table.description: Size of the area around the cursor where the current surges, in px.

table.name: theme
table.description: Glowing light for dark pages, or crisp ink with a white core for light ones.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the wrapper.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the wrapper.

children.$jsx: Your content

name: FadeContent
description: Wrapper that fades content in on scroll, plain or out of focus, from washed-out gray, or through grain, mist and pixel blocks.

table.name: children
table.description: The content to fade in.

table.name: container
table.description: Scroll container that drives the fade, as a selector or an element. Defaults to the page.

table.name: effect
table.description: How the content appears: a plain fade, out of focus, from washed-out gray, through fine grain, through drifting mist, or block by block.

table.name: blur
table.description: Extra blur the content starts from, in px. true adds 10px.

table.name: duration
table.description: Length of the fade, in seconds. Values above 10 are read as milliseconds.

table.name: ease
table.description: Any GSAP ease, such as 'power3.out', 'expo.out' or 'none'.

table.name: delay
table.description: Wait before the fade starts, in seconds. Values above 10 are read as milliseconds.

table.name: threshold
table.description: How far into the viewport the top of the content must be before it fades in, from 0 to 1.

table.name: initialOpacity
table.description: Opacity the content starts from.

table.name: stagger
table.description: Fades each direct child in turn, this many seconds apart. Great for lists and grids.

table.name: staggerFrom
table.description: Which child goes first when staggering.

table.name: trigger
table.description: Fade in when the content scrolls into view, or right away.

table.name: once
table.description: Fades in once. Turn off to fade back out whenever the content scrolls back below the view.

table.name: exit
table.description: Fades the content back out as it scrolls off the top, and in again when it comes back.

table.name: scrub
table.description: Ties the fade to the scroll position instead of playing it. A number smooths it, in seconds.

table.name: disappearAfter
table.description: Fades the content out again this many seconds after it appears. 0 keeps it shown.

table.name: disappearDuration
table.description: Length of the fade out, in seconds.

table.name: disappearEase
table.description: GSAP ease of the fade out.

table.name: onStart
table.description: Called when the fade starts.

table.name: onComplete
table.description: Called when the fade finishes.

table.name: onDisappearanceComplete
table.description: Called when the fade out finishes.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the wrapper.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the wrapper.

name: GlareHover
description: A glossy light streak that sweeps across any element in the direction the cursor moves.

table.name: children
table.description: The content the glare passes over.

table.name: mode
table.description: Sweep on hover, follow the cursor, shine on a timer, or sweep on click.

table.name: variant
table.description: Shape of the glare: one bright streak, a double streak like glass, or a soft wide sheen.

table.name: glareColor
table.description: Color of the glare. Any CSS color.

table.name: glareOpacity
table.description: Brightness of the glare, from 0 to 1.

table.name: glareSize
table.description: Width of the glare as a percentage of the element's diagonal.

table.name: softness
table.description: How soft the core of the glare is, from 0 to 1.

table.name: glareAngle
table.description: Direction the glare travels, in degrees.

table.name: blendMode
table.description: How the glare mixes with the content: screen, normal, overlay or soft-light.

table.name: rimGlint
table.description: Lets the edge catch the light where the glare crosses it.

table.name: transitionDuration
table.description: How long one sweep takes, in milliseconds.

table.name: interval
table.description: Seconds between shines in loop mode.

table.name: playOnce
table.description: In hover mode, sweeps only on the way in instead of again on the way out.

table.name: intro
table.description: Sweeps once when the element first scrolls into view.

table.name: width
table.description: Width of the element.

table.name: height
table.description: Height of the element.

table.name: background
table.description: Background of the element.

table.name: borderRadius
table.description: Corner radius of the element.

table.name: borderColor
table.description: Border color of the element.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the element.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the element.

name: GradualBlur
description: Progressive edge blur for headers, footers, captions and carousels, with an optional fade to color that hides at the ends of a scroll.

table.name: position
table.description: Edge the blur grows toward.

table.name: target
table.description: Sit inside the nearest positioned parent, or stay fixed to the edge of the viewport.

table.name: height
table.description: How far the blur reaches in from the edge. For left and right this is its width. Numbers are px.

table.name: width
table.description: For top and bottom, a narrower centered band. For left and right, overrides height.

table.name: strength
table.description: How blurry the very edge gets. Each step adds about 12px of blur.

table.name: layers
table.description: Blur layers stacked across the ramp. More layers give a smoother falloff, fewer show visible steps.

table.name: curve
table.description: How the blur builds across the ramp. bezier is a smooth S-curve.

table.name: exponential
table.description: Doubles the blur toward the edge so it starts gently. Turn off for an even ramp.

table.name: opacity
table.description: Opacity of the blur layers. Lower values let the sharp content show through.

table.name: saturation
table.description: Color boost of the blurred content, building toward the edge, for a glassy look.

table.name: tint
table.description: Color the content fades into at the edge, such as your page background. Use rgba for a lighter wash.

table.name: autoHide
table.description: Fades the blur out when the scroll container reaches this edge, so it only shows while there is more to scroll.

table.name: container
table.description: Scroll container watched by autoHide. Defaults to a scrollable sibling or the parent, or the page when target is page.

table.name: hoverIntensity
table.description: Multiplies the blur while the cursor is over it. 0 clears it on hover, 2 doubles it.

table.name: duration
table.description: Length of the hover and autoHide transitions, in seconds or as a CSS time.

table.name: easing
table.description: CSS easing of those transitions.

table.name: zIndex
table.description: Stacking order of the overlay.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the overlay.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the overlay.

name: CrystalizedBall
description: A glass ball with a crackling electric rim and glowing dust that swirls with the cursor.

table.name: preset
table.description: A complete starting look, color included. Any prop marked from preset overrides the preset value when you pass it.

table.name: color
table.description: The one color of the ball. The white-hot rim, its glow and flares, the dust tones, sparks and haze are all derived from it.

table.name: theme
table.description: The background the ball sits on. Dark renders it as emitted light. Light draws it in crisp ink with a white-hot rim core.

table.name: size
table.description: Diameter of the ball as a fraction of the smaller side of the container.

table.name: strands
table.description: Number of electric strands braided around the rim, from 1 to 8.

table.name: crackle
table.description: How far the strands bend and jitter. Low values hum quietly, high values crackle.

table.name: flares
table.description: How far the glow licks outward from the rim in slow, travelling flares.

table.name: glow
table.description: Strength of the halo around the rim.

table.name: sparks
table.description: How often small arcs discharge along the inside of the rim. 0 turns them off.

table.name: particleCount
table.description: Number of dust particles in the ball, up to 40000.

table.name: fill
table.description: How full the ball is. Low values pool the dust at the bottom, high values float it up to the top.

table.name: motion
table.description: How the dust moves. Rise floats like embers, fall drifts down like snow, drift wanders and orbit loops in small circles.

table.name: particleShape
table.description: Crisp square pixels or soft round dots.

table.name: depth
table.description: Strength of the depth cues. Dust at the back of the ball gets smaller and dimmer.

table.name: sway
table.description: How much the dust turns back and forth inside the glass, showing its depth.

table.name: twinkle
table.description: How much the dust sparkles on and off.

table.name: haze
table.description: Strength of the glow that pools under the dust and along the inside of the glass.

table.name: speed
table.description: Animation speed of the rim, flares and sparks.

table.name: dustSpeed
table.description: Animation speed of the dust.

table.name: interactive
table.description: Lets the cursor touch the ball. The rim heats up and flares toward it, the dust swirls in its wake and turns toward it, and a click shakes the ball.

table.name: hoverStrength
table.description: How strongly the ball reacts to the cursor, from 0 to 1.

table.name: intro
table.description: On mount the rim powers up and the dust lights up from the bottom of the ball.

table.name: paused
table.description: Freezes the animation. The dust can still be stirred.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the root element.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the root element.

name: ElectricLogo
description: Turns any logo into a living lightning outline, with arcs that leap off its edges.

table.name: src
table.description: Any image URL. SVGs and transparent PNGs are traced by their alpha, opaque images by keying out their backdrop colour.

table.name: color
table.description: Colour of the hot core of every strand.

table.name: glowColor
table.description: Colour of the glow around the strands, the bloom and the interior fill.

table.name: scale
table.description: Size of the logo as a fraction of the container. The glow and arcs extend beyond it.

table.name: intensity
table.description: Overall brightness of the effect.

table.name: glow
table.description: Strength of the halo around strands and the soft bloom around the shape.

table.name: thickness
table.description: Width of the main strand, in px. Satellite strands are thinner, and every strand swells and thins as it flows.

table.name: strands
table.description: Number of filaments tracing the outline, from 1 to 6. Extra strands come and go along the edge.

table.name: bend
table.description: How far the strands sway and ripple away from the outline. The main strand stays closest.

table.name: crackle
table.description: Size of the fine crinkle along every strand and arc.

table.name: arcs
table.description: How often short arcs leap off the edge and land further along it. 0 turns them off.

table.name: flicker
table.description: How much the whole effect pulses and each strand shimmers in brightness.

table.name: fill
table.description: Translucent glow inside the shape, brightest near its edges.

table.name: speed
table.description: Animation speed. 0 freezes the current frame.

table.name: interactive
table.description: Turn on pointer interactions. Hovering charges the lightning around the cursor, and a click sends a ripple through it with a burst of arcs.

table.name: cursorIntensity
table.description: How strongly the lightning charges up around the cursor. 0 turns the hover charge off.

table.name: cursorRadius
table.description: Radius of the charged area around the cursor, in px.

table.name: theme
table.description: The background the logo sits on. Dark renders the lightning as emitted light. Light renders crisp electric ink with a white-hot core and a lighter fill.

table.name: onRender
table.description: Called immediately after each rendered frame. Copy the canvas synchronously to capture the current frame for effects such as live reflections.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra classes on the container.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles on the container.

name: DitherVeil
description: A 1-bit dithered photo the cursor burns through to full colour, knitting back cell by cell.

table.name: src
table.description: Image to veil. Must be served with CORS headers.

table.name: fit
table.description: Show the whole image on the ink, or crop it to fill the container.

table.name: pattern
table.description: How the image is broken into dots: an ordered Bayer grid, blue noise stipple, Atkinson or Floyd-Steinberg error diffusion, or diagonal engraving lines.

table.name: palette
table.description: Duotone maps brightness between the ink and paper colours. RGB dithers each channel for a retro colour look.

table.name: pixelSize
table.description: Size of each dither cell, in px.

table.name: levels
table.description: Tones per channel. 2 is pure 1-bit, higher values add in-between shades.

table.name: inkColor
table.description: Colour of the darkest tone.

table.name: paperColor
table.description: Colour of the lightest tone.

table.name: contrast
table.description: Tonal contrast applied before dithering.

table.name: brightness
table.description: Shifts the image lighter or darker before dithering.

table.name: revealRadius
table.description: Radius of the full-colour window around the cursor, in px.

table.name: softness
table.description: How much of the reveal edge dissolves through the dither. 0 is a hard cut.

table.name: linger
table.description: Seconds the revealed trail takes to knit back into dither. 0 turns the trail off.

table.name: rimColor
table.description: Colour of the cells along the dissolving edge.

table.name: rim
table.description: Thickness of the coloured rim on the dissolving edge. 0 hides it.

table.name: reverse
table.description: Start in full colour and dither wherever the cursor goes.

table.name: wander
table.description: Let the reveal drift around on its own while the pointer is away.

table.name: clickBurst
table.description: Clicking sends a ring of colour rippling out across the image.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra classes on the container.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles on the container.

name: GlowCursor
description: Light that pours from the cursor, drifts softly through the air and cools as it fades.

table.name: color
table.description: Color of the light where it is freshly drawn.

table.name: secondaryColor
table.description: Color the light cools to as it drifts. Leave it out for a deeper shade of the main color.

table.name: intensity
table.description: Brightness of the light.

table.name: trailWidth
table.description: Thickness of the light where it is drawn, in pixels.

table.name: linger
table.description: Seconds the light stays visible before it fades.

table.name: glow
table.description: Strength of the soft glow around the light.

table.name: hotspot
table.description: Strength of the white-hot core near the cursor.

table.name: followSpeed
table.description: How tightly the light follows the cursor, from 0 to 1.

table.name: grain
table.description: Amount of film grain in the light.

table.name: clickBurst
table.description: Releases a burst of light when you click.

table.name: quality
table.description: Resolution of the simulation. Lower it for weaker devices.

table.name: theme
table.description: Use light on light backgrounds for an ink-like look.

table.name: blendMode
table.description: CSS blend mode of the canvas. Defaults to screen in dark and normal in light.

table.name: maxDevicePixelRatio

name: GhostCursor
description: A ghost of glowing smoke that floats after the cursor and curls away as it rises.

table.name: color
table.description: Color of the smoke. Dense parts glow lighter.

table.name: size
table.description: Size of the ghost, in px.

table.name: trailLength
table.description: How long the smoke lingers behind the cursor, from 1 to 200.

table.name: inertia
table.description: How far the ghost floats behind the cursor and glides on when the cursor leaves, from 0 to 0.99.

table.name: turbulence
table.description: How much the smoke swirls and curls as it drifts, from 0 to 2.

table.name: drift
table.description: How fast the smoke rises. Negative values let it sink.

table.name: detail
table.description: How wispy the smoke is, from 0 for a soft glow to 1 for billowing wisps.

table.name: brightness
table.description: Brightness of the smoke.

table.name: bloomStrength
table.description: Strength of the soft glow around the smoke.

table.name: bloomRadius
table.description: How far the glow spreads, from 0 to 3.

table.name: bloomThreshold
table.description: How bright smoke has to be before it glows. Higher values keep the glow on the core.

table.name: grainIntensity
table.description: Film grain over the smoke, from 0 to 1.

table.name: edgeIntensity
table.description: Fades the smoke out toward the edges of the area, from 0 to 1.

table.name: clickPuff
table.description: Clicking releases a puff of smoke.

table.name: intro
table.description: The ghost floats across once when it first appears, before the cursor arrives.

table.name: theme
table.description: Glowing smoke for dark pages, or soft ink smoke for light ones.

table.name: mixBlendMode
table.description: CSS blend mode for the canvas.

table.name: fadeDelayMs
table.description: Time after the cursor stops before the ghost starts to fade, in ms.

table.name: fadeDurationMs
table.description: How long the fade takes, in ms.

table.name: maxDevicePixelRatio
table.description: Highest pixel ratio the canvas renders at.

table.name: targetPixels
table.description: Pixel budget for the smoke. Large areas render it at a lower resolution to stay fast.

table.name: zIndex
table.description: Stacking order of the effect over your content.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the container.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the container.

name: ImageTrail
description: Cursor-based image trail with several built-in variants.

table.name: items
table.description: Image URLs shown in the trail, in order.

table.name: size
table.description: Width of each image in pixels, or any CSS length.

table.name: aspectRatio
table.description: Width divided by height for each image.

table.name: radius
table.description: Corner radius of the images.

table.name: threshold
table.description: How far the cursor travels, in pixels, before the next image appears.

table.name: lifetime
table.description: Seconds an image stays before it fades out.

table.name: appearScale

table.name: zoom
table.description: How far each photo starts zoomed in before settling inside its frame. 1 turns it off.

table.name: flash
table.description: Brightness flash as an image appears, from 0 to 1.

table.name: exitScale
table.description: Size an image shrinks or grows to while it fades out. 1 keeps its size.

table.name: drift
table.description: How far images keep flying in the direction of the cursor as they fade, from 0 to 1.

table.name: rotation
table.description: Random tilt of each image, in degrees.

table.name: sizeVariance
table.description: Random size variation between images, from 0 to 1.

table.name: alignToMotion
table.description: Turns each image to face the direction the cursor is moving.

table.name: stack
table.description: Keeps this many of the newest images on screen in a pile, instead of fading each one on its own. 0 turns it off.

table.name: tilt
table.description: Tilts images in 3D toward the edge where they appear, in degrees.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the container.

name: LogoLoop
description: Continuously looping marquee of brand or tech logos with seamless repeat and hover pause.

table.name: logos
table.description: Logos to show. Each item is either { node } for any React node, like an icon, or { src, alt } for an image. Both accept an optional title, href and hoverColor, the brand color a logo takes on when hovered.

table.name: speed
table.description: Speed in pixels per second. Negative values reverse the direction.

table.name: direction
table.description: Which way the logos travel.

table.name: width
table.description: Width of the loop.

table.name: logoHeight
table.description: Height of each logo in pixels.

table.name: gap
table.description: Space between logos in pixels.

table.name: hoverSpeed
table.description: Speed while the loop is hovered or a logo has keyboard focus. 0 pauses it and a small value slows it down. By default it pauses.

table.name: pauseOnHover
table.description: Set to false to keep full speed on hover. Ignored when hoverSpeed is set.

table.name: fadeOut
table.description: Fades the logos out softly at both ends. It is a transparent mask, so it works on any background.

table.name: fadeOutWidth
table.description: Size of each fade as a fraction of the length, from 0 to 0.5.

table.name: scaleOnHover
table.description: Grows the hovered logo slightly.

table.name: layout
table.description: Path the logos travel along: a straight line, a wave, an arc, or a ring that turns in 3D.

table.name: bend
table.description: How strongly the path bends, from -1 to 1. It sets the height of the wave, the curve of the arc or the tilt of the orbit. Negative values flip it.

table.name: focus
table.description: A lens in the middle, from 0 to 1. Logos grow and make room as they pass the center while the outer ones dim.

table.name: magnify
table.description: Dock-style magnification under the cursor, from 0 to 1. Nearby logos move aside to make room.

table.name: tiltX
table.description: Tilts the loop back or forward in 3D, in degrees.

table.name: tiltY
table.description: Turns the loop to the side in 3D, in degrees.

table.name: step
table.description: Moves one logo at a time and pauses, centering each logo in turn. Speed sets the pace.

table.name: muted
table.description: Greys out and dims the logos until one is hovered or centered, from 0 to 1.

table.name: labels
table.description: Shows each logo's title beside it, below it, or as a small caption when it is hovered or centered.

table.name: draggable
table.description: Lets people drag or swipe the loop and fling it. Links still open with a normal click.

table.name: scrollBoost
table.description: Speeds the loop up while the page scrolls and reverses it when scrolling up, from 0 to 1.

table.name: intro
table.description: Logos fade and rise in from left to right the first time the loop comes into view.

table.name: renderItem
table.description: Custom render function for each logo, for full control over how it looks.

table.name: ariaLabel
table.description: Accessible name for the loop.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the container.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the container.

name: Magnet
description: Elements magnetically ease toward the cursor then settle back with spring physics.

table.name: children
table.description: The content that moves toward the cursor.

table.name: padding
table.description: Distance in pixels around the element where the cursor starts to pull it.

table.name: magnetStrength
table.description: How far the element follows the cursor. The offset is divided by this value, so 1 follows the cursor and higher values move less.

table.name: exclusive
table.description: When several magnets are in range, only the nearest exclusive one is pulled. Turn it off to let a group, like dock icons, lean toward the cursor together.

table.name: axis
table.description: Limits the movement to one axis.

table.name: maxOffset
table.description: Caps how far the element can move from its resting place, in pixels.

table.name: tilt
table.description: Maximum 3D tilt toward the cursor, in degrees.

table.name: scale
table.description: Scale of the element while the cursor pulls it.

table.name: spring
table.type: { stiffness?: number; damping?: number; mass?: number }
table.description: Spring that drives the movement. Higher stiffness reacts faster, lower damping lets it overshoot and wobble back.

table.name: disabled
table.description: Turns the effect off and lets the element spring back to rest.

table.name: onActiveChange
table.description: Called when the cursor enters or leaves the magnetic area. The wrapper also gets a data-magnet-active attribute.

table.name: wrapperClassName
table.description: Class name for the outer wrapper, which stays in place.

table.name: innerClassName
table.description: Class name for the inner element that moves.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the outer wrapper.

name: MetaBalls
description: Liquid metaballs that merge, stretch and pinch apart, with a cursor blob that pushes through them.

table.name: color
table.description: Color of the blobs.

table.name: cursorBallColor
table.description: Color of the cursor blob. It blends smoothly into any blob it merges with.

table.name: variant
table.description: Filled blobs, a single outline, or an outline with contour rings around it.

table.name: motion
table.description: How the blobs move: orbiting a cluster, drifting across the area, or rising and sinking like a lava lamp.

table.name: speed
table.description: Speed of the motion.

table.name: animationSize
table.description: Size of the world shown in the view. Higher values zoom out and make the blobs smaller.

table.name: ballCount
table.description: Number of blobs, up to 50.

table.name: clumpFactor
table.description: How far the blobs travel from the center. Lower values pack them together.

table.name: gooeyness
table.description: How far blobs reach toward each other before merging, from 0 to 1. 0.5 is the classic look.

table.name: stickiness
table.description: How strongly merged blobs cling together before the neck between them snaps, from 0 to 1.

table.name: stretch
table.description: How much blobs stretch in the direction they move, from 0 to 1.

table.name: wobble
table.description: How much blobs jiggle after stretching or being pushed, from 0 to 1.

table.name: enableMouseInteraction
table.description: The cursor blob follows the pointer and pushes the others aside. It orbits on its own otherwise.

table.name: cursorBallSize
table.description: Size of the cursor blob.

table.name: hoverSmoothness
table.description: How quickly the cursor blob catches up with the pointer. Lower is smoother.

table.name: clickBurst
table.description: Clicking makes the cursor blob pulse and splash the others outward before they flow back.

table.name: lineWidth
table.description: Width of the lines in the outline and contour variants, in px.

table.name: rings
table.description: Number of contour rings around the outline.

table.name: intro
table.description: Starts as a single drop that buds into the blobs the first time it comes into view.

table.name: enableTransparency
table.description: Renders on a transparent background instead of black.

table.name: paused
table.description: Freezes the animation.

table.name: dpr
table.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the container.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the container.

name: Strands
description: Spectral strands that twist inside a frosted glass orb and swell into a smooth bulge where they come together, like the new Siri.

table.name: colors
table.description: Colors of the strands, in order: the red top edge of the bulge, orange, amber, the warm white core, cyan, blue and deep blue. Fewer colors are spread across these roles.

table.name: count
table.description: How many strands show inside the bulge of light, from 1 to 3.

table.name: speed
table.description: How fast the light turns. 0 holds it still.

table.name: amplitude
table.description: How tall the arch rises and how deeply the ribbon curves.

table.name: waviness
table.description: How tightly the ribbon twists along its length.

table.name: energy
table.description: How lively the light is on its own, from 0 to 1. 0 rests as a calm white line, 1 keeps the ribbons fully open.

table.name: thickness
table.description: How thick the edges of the light are, and the white core where the ribbon turns edge-on.

table.name: spread
table.description: How wide the ribbon opens, fanning its colors out.

table.name: glow
table.description: Strength of the soft glow around the light.

table.name: taper
table.description: How quickly the light fades toward the sides of the orb.

table.name: intensity
table.description: Overall brightness of the light.

table.name: saturation
table.description: Color saturation of the light. 0 is greyscale.

table.name: hueShift
table.description: Rotates the colors of the light around the color wheel, from 0 to 1.

table.name: scale
table.description: Width of the light.

table.name: glass
table.description: Shows the glass orb. Turn it off for the light on its own.

table.name: glassSize
table.description: Size of the glass orb.

table.name: refraction
table.description: How strongly the edge of the glass bends the light, wrapping the colors around its rim.

table.name: rim
table.description: Brightness of the glass rim and the light it catches.

table.name: dispersion
table.description: Amount of rainbow color separation along the edge of the glass.

table.name: listening
table.description: Animates the orb as if it were hearing someone speak.

table.name: level
table.description: Drives the orb from your own audio level, from 0 to 1, for example a microphone volume. Overrides listening.

table.name: interactive
table.description: The light tilts toward the cursor and stirs as it gets close.

table.name: clickPulse
table.description: Clicking sends a burst of motion through the light.

table.name: intro
table.description: The orb fades in and the light unfolds from the center when it first appears.

table.name: lightMode
table.description: For light pages. The orb turns into frosted white glass and the strands use deeper colors with a warm core.

table.name: opacity
table.description: Overall opacity.

table.name: maxDevicePixelRatio
table.description: Highest pixel ratio the canvas renders at.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the container.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the container.

name: MetallicPaint

table.name: text

table.name: fontFamily
table.description: Font used for text.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Font weight used for text.

table.name: color

table.name: backgroundColor
table.description: Color behind the shape. By default the canvas is transparent.

table.name: density
table.description: How many reflection bands run across the shape.

table.name: softness
table.description: Softness of the reflection edges, from 0 for crisp chrome to 1 for brushed metal.

table.name: dispersion
table.description: Rainbow fringes where the reflections bend, from 0 to 1.

table.name: distortion
table.description: How much the reflections ripple as they flow, from 0 to 1.

table.name: edgeBend
table.description: How strongly the reflections bend around the edges of the shape, from 0 to 1.

table.name: angle
table.description: Direction the reflections flow in, in degrees.

table.name: speed
table.description: Speed of the flow. 0 freezes it.

table.name: scale
table.description: Size of the shape inside the canvas.

table.name: rotation
table.description: Rotation of the shape, in degrees.

table.description: How much the reflections shift as the cursor moves, as if tilting the metal.

table.description: Adds a soft dark rim and dims the brightest highlights so the shape reads on light pages.

table.name: intro
table.description: Pours the metal in from the outline on mount.

table.name: paused
table.description: Freezes the animation.

table.name: dpr

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the container.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the container.

description: Film grain overlay for photos and pages, from fine 35mm grain to dust, paper and TV static.

table.name: opacity
table.description: Strength of the grain, from 0 to 1.

table.name: size
table.description: Size of each grain in CSS pixels. 0.5 is one device pixel on retina screens.

table.name: fps
table.description: How many times per second the grain changes. 0 keeps it still, like a paper texture.

table.name: contrast
table.description: From soft, fine grain at 0 to harsh, punchy grain at 1.

table.name: scratches
table.description: How often thin vertical scratches run down the frame for a few seconds, from 0 to 1.

table.name: colored
table.description: Uses colored grain instead of gray.

table.name: scanlines
table.description: Adds rolling horizontal lines, like an old screen, from 0 to 1.

table.name: flicker
table.description: Makes the grain strength jump a little every frame, like a film projector.

table.name: fixed
table.description: Covers the whole viewport instead of the nearest positioned parent.

table.name: zIndex
table.description: Stacking order of the overlay.

table.name: className

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the overlay.

name: PixelTrail

table.description: Number of pixels across the longer side.

table.name: trailSize
table.description: Radius of the trail brush, as a fraction of the longer side.

table.name: maxAge
table.description: How long each part of the trail lasts, in ms.

table.name: interpolate
table.description: How many in-between points fill gaps on fast moves. Higher is smoother.

table.name: easingFunction

table.name: color

table.description: Melts neighbouring pixels into liquid blobs. Higher strength rounds them more. Pass false for separate pixels.

table.name: shape

table.name: gap

table.name: decay
table.description: How pixels disappear: fading out, shrinking away or dropping out in a dither pattern.

table.name: flow
table.description: How much the trail keeps drifting in the direction the cursor moved, from 0 to 1.

table.description: Makes the trail sag down as it fades. Negative values make it rise, from -1 to 1.

table.name: sparkle

table.name: glow

table.name: clickBurst
table.description: Clicking splashes a ring of trail out from the cursor.

table.name: imageSrc

table.name: dpr
table.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the container.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the container.

table.name: firstContent

table.name: secondContent

table.name: gridSize

table.name: pixelColor

table.name: mosaic
table.description: Gives each pixel a slightly different tone of the pixel color, from 0 to 1.

table.name: animationStepDuration

table.description: Breaks up the ripple and wipe fronts, from 0 to 1.

table.description: What starts the transition.

table.name: onActiveChange
table.description: Called when hover, focus or a click asks for the other content.

table.name: aspectRatio

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the card.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the card.

table.name: firstContent
table.description: Content shown at rest.

table.name: secondContent
table.description: Content that builds in pixel by pixel.

table.name: pattern
table.description: Order the pixels arrive in. Pointer starts the wave where the cursor enters, leaves or clicks.

table.name: pixelSize

table.name: gap
table.description: Space between pixels in px while they grow.

table.name: pixelRadius
table.description: Corner rounding of the pixels while they grow, as a percentage. 50 starts them as dots.

table.name: pixelScale
table.description: Size each pixel pops in at, from 0 to grow out of nothing to 0.9 for a hard pop.

table.name: pixelSpin
table.description: Degrees each pixel turns as it grows in.

table.name: duration
table.description: Time in ms the wave takes to cross the content.

table.name: pixelDuration
table.description: Time in ms a single pixel takes to grow.

table.name: randomness
table.description: Noise mixed into the pattern, from 0 for a clean wave to 1 for a scatter.

table.name: bounce
table.description: How far each pixel overshoots before it settles, from 0 to 1.

table.name: trigger
table.description: What starts the swap. With none, drive it with active.

table.name: intro
table.description: Builds the first content in from pixels on mount.

table.name: initialActive

table.name: active
table.description: Controls which content shows. Pair it with onActiveChange.

table.name: onActiveChange
table.description: Called when the trigger asks to swap.

table.name: onComplete
table.description: Called when a swap finishes.

table.name: aspectRatio
table.description: Aspect ratio of the root.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the root.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the root.

table.name: length

table.name: spread
table.description: Space between the ribbons, in pixels.

table.name: stiffness
table.description: How tightly the ribbons chase the cursor, from 0 to 1.

table.name: bounce

table.name: backgroundColor
table.description: Color behind the ribbons. By default the canvas is transparent.

table.name: style

table.name: style

table.name: intensity
table.description: How much ink each movement leaves behind.

table.name: width

table.name: rotate

table.name: curlRadius

table.name: backColor
table.description: Color of the back of the sticker, seen on the peeled part.

table.name: lightingIntensity

table.name: shadowIntensity

table.name: draggable

table.name: swing

table.name: initialPosition

table.name: onDragStart

table.name: onDragEnd

table.name: className

table.name: style

table.name: cursorColor

table.name: cursorColorOnTarget
table.description: Color the cursor blends to while locked onto a target.

table.name: spinDuration

table.name: hoverDuration
table.description: How long the brackets take to snap onto a target, in seconds.

table.name: parallaxOn

table.name: hideDefaultCursor
table.description: Hides the system cursor while this cursor is shown.

table.name: size
table.description: Size of the reticle while roaming, in px.

table.name: cornerSize

table.name: thickness
table.description: Stroke width of the brackets, in px.

table.name: padding
table.description: Gap between a locked target and the brackets, in px.

table.name: matchRadius
table.description: Rounds the brackets to follow the target's corner radius.

table.name: dotSize
table.description: Size of the center dot, in px. 0 hides it.

table.name: blendMode
table.description: CSS blend mode of the cursor. Difference keeps it visible on any background.

table.name: showLabel
table.description: Shows the data-cursor-label text of a locked target above the brackets.

table.name: clickEffect
table.description: Squeezes the brackets and dot while the mouse button is held.

table.name: container
table.description: Limits the cursor to one element. By default it works across the whole page.

name: LaserFlow
description: A beam of light that splashes onto your content and pours over its corners.

table.name: surfaceRef
table.description: Element the beam lands on. The light spreads along its top edge and spills over its corners.

table.name: beamPosition
table.description: Horizontal position of the beam, from 0 at the left edge to 1 at the right edge.

table.name: surfaceLevel
table.description: Where the beam lands when no surfaceRef is given, from 0 at the top to 1 at the bottom.

table.name: color
table.description: Color of the light. Every other tone is derived from it.

table.name: intensity
table.description: Overall brightness of the light.

table.name: beamWidth
table.description: Thickness of the beam and its glow.

table.name: flare
table.description: Size of the splash where the beam meets the surface.

table.name: spread
table.description: How far the light travels along the surface.

table.name: spill
table.description: How much light pours over the corners of the surface.

table.name: fog
table.description: Amount of smoke lit up by the beam. 0 turns it off.

table.name: dust
table.description: Amount of glittering dust flowing with the light.

table.name: streaks
table.description: Brightness of the fine lines flowing along the splash.

table.name: dots
table.description: Strength of the fine dot texture in the glow.

table.name: pulse
table.description: How much the splash breathes over time.

table.name: speed
table.description: Animation speed. 0 holds the light still.

table.name: seed
table.description: Changes the shape of the smoke.

table.name: mouseInteraction
table.description: Brightens the light, smoke and dust softly around the cursor.

table.name: revealImage
table.description: Image revealed through the light around the cursor, such as a screenshot of your UI.

table.name: revealRadius
table.description: Radius of the reveal around the cursor, in pixels.

table.name: revealOpacity
table.description: Strength of the revealed image. 0 hides it.

table.name: intro
table.description: Drops the beam in and lets the light run along the surface on mount.

table.name: theme
table.description: Use light for light page backgrounds.

table.name: paused
table.description: Freezes the animation.

table.name: dpr
table.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the container.

name: Antigravity
description: A field of particles that lifts into a glowing ring around the cursor and bursts outward on click.

table.name: colors
table.description: Palette the particles are colored from. How it is spread depends on colorMode.

table.name: color
table.description: A single color for every particle. Overrides colors when set.

table.name: colorMode
table.description: Spreads the palette around the cursor, outward from the ring, or gives each particle a random color from it.

table.name: colorSpeed
table.description: How fast the conic palette turns around the cursor. 0 keeps it still.

table.name: particleShape
table.description: Shape of the particles. Capsules stretch into dashes that point at the cursor.

table.name: count
table.description: Number of particles in the field.

table.name: particleSize
table.description: Size of the particles.

table.name: particleVariance
table.description: How much each particle pulses in size, from 0 to 1.

table.name: magnetRadius
table.description: Size of the area around the cursor whose particles get pulled into the ring.

table.name: ringRadius
table.description: Radius of the ring the particles form.

table.name: fieldStrength
table.description: How tightly the particles line up on the ring. Lower values spread them into a wider band.

table.name: waveAmplitude
table.description: How much the ring ripples. 0 gives a clean circle.

table.name: waveCount
table.description: Number of ripples around the ring. Pair with a high waveAmplitude for a flower shape.

table.name: waveSpeed
table.description: How fast the ripples travel around the ring.

table.name: rotationSpeed
table.description: How fast the particles orbit the cursor. Negative values orbit the other way.

table.name: pulseSpeed
table.description: How fast the particles pulse in size.

table.name: depthFactor
table.description: Strength of the 3D depth. Particles in front grow, particles behind shrink and soften.

table.name: ambient
table.description: How visible the particles away from the ring are, from 0 to 1.

table.name: lerpSpeed
table.description: How quickly the particles follow the cursor. Lower values leave longer trails.

table.name: autoAnimate
table.description: The ring drifts around on its own after a couple of seconds without cursor movement.

table.name: interactive
table.description: The ring follows the cursor or finger. Turn off for a purely ambient background.

table.name: clickBurst
table.description: Pressing pulls the ring in and spins it faster. Releasing blasts the particles outward.

table.name: intro
table.description: The particles float up into place on mount.

table.name: lightMode
table.description: Deepens pale colors so the particles stay visible on light backgrounds.

table.name: opacity
table.description: Overall opacity, from 0 to 1.

table.name: maxDevicePixelRatio
table.description: Highest pixel ratio the canvas renders at.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the container.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the container.

name: OrbitImages
description: SVG Path customizable orbiting images effect

table.name: images
table.description: Images that travel along the path, as URLs or objects with their own alt text.

table.name: altPrefix
table.description: Prefix for the alt text of images given as plain URLs.

table.name: shape
table.description: Shape of the path the images follow.

table.name: customPath
table.description: Your own SVG path, drawn in a baseWidth by baseWidth space. Used when shape is custom.

table.name: baseWidth
table.description: Size of the coordinate space for the radii, the item size and custom paths.

table.name: radiusX
table.description: Horizontal radius for the ellipse, rectangle, infinity and wave.

table.name: radiusY
table.description: Vertical radius for the ellipse, rectangle, infinity and wave.

table.name: radius
table.description: Radius for the circle, square, triangle, star and heart.

table.name: starPoints
table.description: Number of points on the star.

table.name: starInnerRatio
table.description: Inner radius of the star as a fraction of the outer one.

table.name: rotation
table.description: Rotation of the whole path in degrees. Images stay upright.

table.name: duration
table.description: Seconds for one full lap.

table.name: itemSize
table.description: Size of each image, in the same units as the radii.

table.name: direction
table.description: Which way the images travel.

table.name: fill
table.description: Spreads the images evenly around the whole path. Turn it off to make them follow each other in a train.

table.name: depth
table.description: Sense of depth, from 0 to 1. Images at the back get smaller, dimmer and pass behind the center content, and images at the front grow and pass in front of it.

table.name: alignToPath
table.description: Turns each image to follow the curve instead of staying upright.

table.name: itemRadius
table.description: Corner radius of the images, in the same units as itemSize, or any CSS length. Half of itemSize makes circles.

table.name: shadow
table.description: Strength of the soft shadow under each image, from 0 to 1.

table.name: hoverScale
table.description: How much an image grows when hovered.

table.name: hoverSpeed
table.description: Speed while the orbit is hovered, as a fraction of the normal speed. 0 pauses it and 1 keeps full speed.

table.name: draggable
table.description: Lets people drag or swipe sideways to spin the orbit, and fling it.

table.name: clickToFront
table.description: Clicking an image glides it around to the front.

table.name: onItemClick
table.description: Called when an image is clicked. When set, the images become keyboard-focusable buttons.

table.name: showPath
table.description: Draws the path the images follow.

table.name: pathColor
table.description: Color of the path line.

table.name: pathWidth
table.description: Width of the path line in pixels.

table.name: pathDash
table.description: Dash length of the path line in pixels. 0 draws a solid line.

table.name: easing
table.description: Easing applied to each lap.

table.name: paused
table.description: Stops the orbit. Dragging still works.

table.name: text

table.name: asciiFontSize

table.name: colors

table.name: textColor
table.description: Color of the text behind the characters.

table.name: fontFamily
table.description: Font for the text and the characters.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Weight of the rendered text.

table.name: textScale
table.description: Size of the text relative to the container.

table.name: blocks
table.description: Opacity of the colored pixel blocks under the characters, from 0 to 1.

table.name: waves
table.description: Strength of the wavy motion. 0 keeps the text flat.

table.name: waveSpeed
table.description: Speed of the wavy motion.

table.name: chroma

table.name: tilt
table.description: How far the text turns toward the pointer.

table.name: hueShift

table.name: scramble

table.description: Sends a ring of characters across the canvas from where you click.

table.name: intro
table.description: Decodes the text out of random characters on load.

table.name: idle
table.description: Sways the text gently when nobody interacts.

table.name: interactive
table.description: Reacts to the pointer with tilt, hue, scramble and ripples.

table.description: Light inverts the colors so the effect works on white pages.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the container.

table.name: text
table.description: The text content to animate.

table.name: animateBy
table.description: Whether each word or each letter comes into focus on its own.

table.name: direction
table.description: Side the words or letters move in from. Drift always glides sideways, from the right only when set to right.

table.name: staggerFrom
table.description: Where the stagger starts: the first piece, the middle, the last piece or a shuffled order.

table.name: trigger
table.description: When the text comes in. View waits until it scrolls into view and load starts right away. Hover and click show the text and replay it each time it is hovered or clicked.

table.name: delay
table.description: Delay between animations for each word/letter (in ms).

table.name: stepDuration
table.description: The time taken for each step of the animation (in seconds).

table.name: loop
table.description: Keeps replaying: the text holds, blurs back out and comes in again.

table.name: loopDelay
table.description: How long the text stays sharp before it blurs out again when looping, in seconds.

table.name: blur
table.description: How blurred each word or letter starts, in px.

table.name: distance
table.description: How far each word or letter travels into place, in px. 0 keeps them still so they only come into focus.

table.name: color
table.description: Color of the text. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

table.name: fromColor
table.description: Color each word or letter starts in before it settles on the text color. Leave it out to keep one color.

table.name: focusOnHover
table.description: Hovering a word keeps it sharp while the other words soften and dim.

table.name: threshold
table.description: Intersection threshold for triggering the animation.

table.name: rootMargin

table.name: animationTo
table.description: Custom keyframes to animate through after animationFrom.

table.name: easing
table.description: Motion easing applied to every step. Each effect uses its own tuned curves when this is left out.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the paragraph.

table.name: onAnimationComplete
table.description: Called each time the text finishes coming in.

table.name: spinDuration
table.description: Seconds for one full turn. 0 keeps the ring still until it is dragged.

table.name: direction
table.description: Which way the ring turns.

table.name: draggable
table.description: Lets people grab the ring and fling it. It coasts with inertia, then eases back to its cruise speed.

table.name: hoverTilt
table.description: How far the ring tilts in 3D toward the pointer, in degrees. 0 turns the tilt off.

table.description: Leans the ring back in perspective, in degrees, so it orbits around the center content like a planet ring.

table.name: size
table.description: Diameter of the ring, in px.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: Size of the letters, in px.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Weight of the letters.

table.name: letterSpacing
table.description: Extra space between letters, in em. Applies when fill is off.

table.description: Color of the letters and center content. Leave empty to follow the surrounding text color.

table.description: Where the first letter sits, in degrees clockwise from the top.

table.description: Spreads the letters evenly around the whole ring. Turn it off to keep natural letter spacing and leave a gap.

table.name: repeat
table.description: How many times the text repeats around the ring. With fill off, each copy gets its own gap.

table.name: ring
table.description: Draws a thin circle just inside the letters.

table.name: ringColor
table.description: Color of the inner circle. Leave empty to match the letters.

table.description: Extra class names for the ring.

name: CountUp

table.name: to
table.description: The target number to count up to.

table.name: from
table.description: The initial number from which the count starts.

table.name: easing
table.description: Pace of the count. Spring overshoots slightly and settles on the final number.

table.name: format
table.description: Compact shortens large numbers to 1.2K, 3.4M or 5.6B.

table.name: decimals
table.description: Fixed number of decimals. When not set, it follows the decimals in from and to.

table.name: direction
table.description: Direction of the count; can be "up" or "down". When this is set to "down", "from" and "to" become reversed, in order to count down.

table.name: trigger
table.description: View starts the count when the number scrolls into view, load starts it right away.

table.name: replayOnHover
table.description: Replays the count on hover. In roll mode every column spins once more and lands on the same number.

table.name: delay
table.description: Delay in seconds before the counting starts.

table.name: duration
table.description: How long the count takes, in seconds. It lands on the final number right on time.

table.name: className
table.description: CSS class to apply to the component for additional styling.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the number, like its font size or weight.

table.name: startWhen
table.description: A boolean to control whether the animation should start when the component is in view. It basically works like an if statement, if this is true, the count will start.

table.name: separator
table.description: Character to use as a thousands separator in the displayed number.

table.name: prefix
table.description: Text shown before the number, like a currency sign.

table.name: suffix
table.description: Text shown after the number, like a percent sign or a unit.

table.name: onStart
table.description: Callback function that is called when the count animation starts.

table.name: onEnd
table.description: Callback function that is called when the count animation ends.

name: CurvedLoop

table.description: The text that loops along the path. Repeats are joined with a space.

table.name: shape

table.name: color
table.description: Color of the text, or of its outline when outline is on. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

table.name: separator
table.description: A mark placed between repeats, such as ✦ or /. Leave empty to join repeats with a space.

table.name: separatorColor
table.description: Paints the separator in its own solid color. Matches the text when left unset.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Weight of the letters.

table.name: letterSpacing

table.name: className

table.description: The text to decrypt.

table.description: Color of letters while they are scrambled. Each letter eases back to the text color as it decodes. Leave empty to keep the text color.

table.name: speed
table.description: Time between steps, in ms.

table.name: maxIterations
table.description: How many steps the letters scramble before settling when not sequential. Also sets how long letters keep scrambling after the cursor passes with hoverRadius.

table.name: sequential
table.description: Reveals one letter per step instead of all at once.

table.name: revealDirection
table.description: Where the sequential reveal starts. Random uncovers the letters in a shuffled order.

table.name: useOriginalCharsOnly
table.description: Scrambles using only the letters already in the text.

table.name: characters
table.description: The pool of characters used while scrambling.

table.name: animateOn
table.description: What starts the decryption. View and click start scrambled, so the real text never flashes first.

table.name: clickMode
table.description: With click, decrypt once or toggle back and forth. Only applies when animateOn is 'click'.

table.name: hoverRadius
table.description: With hover, only letters within this many px of the cursor scramble, fading out toward the edge, and they settle once it passes. 0 decrypts the whole text on hover.

table.name: loop
table.description: After decrypting, holds, scrambles the text again and repeats. Pauses while off screen.

table.name: loopDelay

name: FallingText

table.name: text
table.description: The text that falls apart.

table.name: highlightWords
table.description: Words that start with any of these strings get the accent color, or the accent tile in the tiles variant.

table.name: highlightClass
table.description: Extra class added to highlighted words.

table.name: trigger

table.name: variant

table.name: split
table.description: Whether whole words or single letters fall.

table.name: order

table.name: stagger

table.name: gravity

table.name: bounciness

table.name: scatter

table.name: draggable

table.name: mouseConstraintStiffness

table.name: cursorPush

table.name: restoreDelay

table.name: fontSize

table.name: accentColor

table.name: theme

table.name: backgroundColor
