name: FuzzyText
description: Vibrating fuzzy text with controllable hover intensity.

table.name: children
table.description: The text to draw.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: Font size as any CSS size or a number in px. Responsive sizes are redrawn when the window resizes.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Font weight of the text.

table.name: fontFamily
table.description: Font family of the text. 'inherit' uses the font of the surrounding text.

table.name: color
table.description: Color of the text. Follows the surrounding text color by default, including theme switches.

table.name: colorSplit
table.description: Splits the text into offset red, green and blue copies that tear apart with the fuzz, from 0 to 1. Dark text splits into print-style cyan, magenta and yellow instead.

table.name: trigger
table.description: What raises the fuzz. 'hover' reacts to the pointer, 'always' holds the hover intensity, 'click' fires a burst that eases back.

table.name: enableHover
table.description: Raises the fuzz to the hover intensity while the pointer is over the text, when trigger is 'hover'.

table.name: baseIntensity
table.description: How strong the fuzz is at rest.

table.name: hoverIntensity
table.description: How strong the fuzz is while hovered. With trigger 'always' it is the constant level, with 'click' it sets how hard each burst hits.

table.name: fuzzRange
table.description: Furthest the strips can shift, in px.

table.name: sliceSize
table.description: Thickness of each shifted strip, in px. 1 gives a fine fuzz, larger values tear the text into bands.

table.name: fps
table.description: Frame rate cap. Lower values look choppier and use less CPU.

table.name: direction
table.description: Which way the strips shift.

table.name: transitionDuration
table.description: How many frames the fuzz takes to ease between intensities. 0 switches instantly.

table.name: intro
table.description: Fades the text in as heavy, coarse static that resolves into clean letters the first time it is seen.

table.name: introDuration
table.description: How long the intro takes to resolve, in ms.

table.name: clickEffect
table.description: Gives a short burst of full intensity on click when trigger is 'hover' or 'always'.

table.name: glitchMode
table.description: Adds bursts of full intensity at a regular interval.

table.name: glitchInterval
table.description: Time between glitch bursts, in ms.

table.name: glitchDuration
table.description: Length of each glitch burst, in ms.

table.name: gradient
table.description: Two or more colors to fill the text with a left to right gradient instead of a single color.

table.name: letterSpacing
table.description: Extra space between letters, in px.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the canvas.

name: GlitchText
description: RGB split and distortion glitch effect with jitter effects.

table.name: children
table.description: The text content that will display the glitch effect.

table.name: mode
table.description: Style of glitch. Slices shifts bands of the text sideways, rgb splits it into jittering color channels, scan sweeps a displaced band down through it and noise briefly swaps letters for glyphs.

table.name: trigger
table.description: When it glitches: all the time, while hovered, or in a short burst on each click.

table.name: speed
table.description: Multiplier for the animation speed. Higher values slow down the glitch effect.

table.name: intensity
table.description: How often and how far it glitches, from 0 (calm) to 1 (constant, wide jolts).

table.name: burstDuration
table.description: Length of the burst played on each click with the click trigger, in seconds.

table.name: flicker
table.description: Adds quick, subtle dips in opacity while it glitches.

table.name: offset
table.description: How far the glitched slices shift sideways, in px. The colored shadows grow with it.

table.name: skew
table.description: How far the text shears sideways during a jolt, in degrees.

table.name: enableShadows
table.description: Toggle the glitch colors. Without them every mode stays in the text color.

table.name: shadowColors
table.description: The two glitch colors: the shadows on the shifted slices, the split channels and the swapped glyphs.

table.name: color
table.description: Color of the text. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: Font size of the text. Numbers are in px.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Font weight of the text.

table.name: enableOnHover
table.description: Same as trigger="hover": the glitch only runs while the text is hovered.

table.name: className
table.description: Additional custom classes to apply to the component.

name: GradientText
description: Living gradients inside your text: a sliding sweep, a drifting mesh or a swinging conic fan.

table.name: children
table.description: The text to fill with the gradient.

table.name: colors
table.description: Colors of the gradient, in order. The first color is repeated at the end so loops stay seamless.

table.name: animationSpeed
table.description: Seconds for one full cycle of the animation.

table.name: variant
table.description: How the colors move. Linear slides a gradient through the text, flow drifts soft blobs of color around like a living mesh gradient and conic swings colors around the center.

table.name: angle
table.description: Direction of the gradient in degrees. 90 runs left to right, 180 top to bottom.

table.name: scale
table.description: How broad the colors are. Higher values show fewer colors at once in longer, calmer bands.

table.name: yoyo
table.description: Eases back and forth instead of scrolling the gradient in one direction forever.

table.name: glow
table.description: A soft bloom of the gradient colors around the letters, from 0 to 1.

table.name: showBorder
table.description: Wraps the text in a pill with an animated gradient outline that works on any background.

table.name: borderWidth
table.description: Thickness of the outline in px.

table.name: pauseOnHover
table.description: Holds the colors still while the pointer is over the text.

table.name: followPointer
table.description: While hovered, the colors are drawn toward the pointer.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the root element.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the root element.

name: RotatingText
description: Cycles through multiple phrases with 3D rotate / flip transitions.

table.name: texts
table.description: The texts to rotate through.

table.name: effect
table.description: How letters swap. Flip rolls them over like a drum, blur dissolves them, scale zooms through and drop lets them fall in with a small bounce.

table.name: direction
table.description: Which way letters travel. Drop always falls from above.

table.name: highlight
table.description: Puts the rotating text on a colored block that smoothly resizes to fit each new text, with a text color picked for contrast.

table.name: highlightColor
table.description: Color of the highlight block. Hex or rgb colors also set a readable text color automatically.

table.name: rotationInterval
table.description: Time each text stays on screen, in milliseconds.

table.name: blur
table.description: Blurs letters as they come and go, in px. The blur effect uses 10 when this is 0.

table.name: staggerDuration
table.description: Delay between letters, in seconds.

table.name: staggerFrom
table.description: Which letter moves first. A number starts from that letter, random shuffles the order.

table.name: splitBy
table.description: How each text is split into moving pieces. Any other string is used as the separator.

table.name: loop
table.description: Goes back to the first text after the last one.

table.name: auto
table.description: Rotates on its own. Turn off to drive it with the ref methods.

table.name: pauseOnHover
table.description: Holds the current text while the pointer is over it.

table.name: initial
table.description: Overrides the state each letter enters from. Leave unset to use the effect.

table.name: animate
table.description: Overrides the state each letter settles into.

table.name: exit
table.description: Overrides the state each letter leaves to.

table.name: transition
table.description: Overrides the Motion transition used for every letter. Each effect brings its own by default.

table.name: animatePresenceMode
table.description: 'wait' lets the old text leave before the new one enters, 'sync' runs both at once.

table.name: animatePresenceInitial
table.description: Animates the first text in on mount.

table.name: onNext
table.description: Called with the new index whenever the text changes.

table.name: mainClassName
table.description: Extra class names for the outer element.

table.name: splitLevelClassName
table.description: Extra class names for each group of letters. Add overflow hidden here for a masked slide.

table.name: elementLevelClassName
table.description: Extra class names for each moving letter.

name: ScrambledText
description: Detects cursor position and applies a distortion effect to text.

table.name: children
table.description: The text to scramble.

table.name: effect
table.description: What happens to letters near the pointer: they scramble, rise, blur, or swell like a lens. Each one eases in and out with a soft falloff.

table.name: radius
table.description: Distance from the pointer, in px, within which letters react.

table.name: strength
table.description: How far letters lift, how much they blur, or how much they magnify.

table.name: trail
table.description: How long lifted, blurred or magnified letters take to settle after the pointer moves on, in seconds. Scrambling uses duration instead.

table.name: duration
table.description: How long a letter right under the pointer keeps scrambling, in seconds. Also sets the pace of the intro and the click burst.

table.name: speed
table.description: How often a scrambling letter swaps to a new character. Higher values flicker faster.

table.name: clickBurst
table.description: Clicking sends a scramble wave outward from the click point, carrying the current effect with it.

table.name: scrambleChars
table.description: The characters shown while a letter is scrambled.

table.name: scrambleColor
table.description: Color of letters while they are scrambled. Leave empty to keep the text color.

table.name: color
table.description: Color of the text. Leave empty to follow the surrounding text color.

table.name: fontFamily
table.description: Font of the text. Leave empty to keep the default monospace.

table.name: intro
table.description: Decodes the whole text from scrambled characters the first time it scrolls into view.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the wrapper.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the wrapper.

name: ScrollFloat
description: Text gently floats / parallax shifts on scroll.

table.name: children
table.description: The text to animate. Plain text is split into letters or words, anything else moves in as one piece.

table.name: scrollContainerRef
table.description: Ref to the element that scrolls. Leave it out to use the page.

table.name: effect
table.description: How the pieces arrive. Float stretches them up out of a slot, flip rolls them in on a drum, scatter assembles them from random spots, blur pulls them into focus and wave makes them swell in on a rolling wave.

table.name: splitBy
table.description: Animate each letter on its own or each word as one piece.

table.name: direction
table.description: Whether the pieces come in from below or from above.

table.name: order
table.description: Which pieces go first. The order is fixed, so random looks the same on every visit.

table.name: fromColor
table.description: Color the pieces start in before they settle into the text color. Keep currentColor for no color change.

table.name: animationDuration
table.description: Length of each piece's move compared to the stagger. Higher values move the pieces more together.

table.name: ease
table.description: Any GSAP ease, such as 'power3.out', 'elastic.out(1, 0.45)' or 'none'.

table.name: stagger
table.description: Delay between pieces. Higher values make the text form one piece at a time.

table.name: distance
table.description: How far the pieces travel, as a percentage of their height. For flip it sets the size of the drum they roll around, for scatter how widely they start apart.

table.name: stretch
table.description: How tall the pieces are stretched while they rise in the float and wave effects. 1 keeps their shape.

table.name: smoothing
table.description: Seconds the pieces take to catch up with the scroll. 0 ties them to it directly.

table.name: scrollStart
table.description: Scroll position where the animation starts, in ScrollTrigger syntax.

table.name: scrollEnd
table.description: Scroll position where the pieces settle. Text near the end of the page still settles fully.

table.name: containerClassName
table.description: Extra class names for the heading.

table.name: textClassName
table.description: Extra class names for the text.

name: ScrollReveal
description: Text gently unblurs and reveals on scroll.

table.name: children
table.description: The text to reveal. Plain text is split into words, characters or lines, anything else is revealed as one piece.

table.name: scrollContainerRef
table.description: Ref to the element that scrolls. Leave it out to use the page.

table.name: highlightColor
table.description: Accent each word lights up to while it is being revealed, before it settles to the text color. Leave empty for no highlight.

table.name: mode
table.description: 'scrub' ties the reveal to the scroll position, 'enter' plays it once when the text scrolls into view.

table.name: splitBy
table.description: What each step of the reveal is. 'lines' groups the words of each rendered line and regroups on resize.

table.name: effect
table.description: How each piece appears. 'fade' brightens in place, 'rise' slides up from behind its own baseline, 'flip' stands up from flat and 'scale' pops up from small.

table.name: stagger
table.description: Spacing between pieces. Higher values reveal them one at a time instead of in a soft wave. In enter mode it is in seconds.

table.name: duration
table.description: Seconds each piece takes to appear when mode is 'enter'.

table.name: smoothing
table.description: Seconds the reveal takes to catch up with the scroll. 0 ties it to the scroll directly.

table.name: enableBlur
table.description: Starts each piece out of focus and sharpens it as it appears.

table.name: blurStrength
table.description: How blurred the pieces start, in px.

table.name: baseOpacity
table.description: Opacity of the pieces before they are revealed, from 0 to 1.

table.name: baseRotation
table.description: Tilt of the whole block before it levels out, in degrees. 0 keeps it level.

table.name: baseOffset
table.description: How far below its place each piece starts, in px. Pieces rise into place as they appear.

table.name: rotationEnd
table.description: Scroll position where the block finishes leveling out in scrub mode, in ScrollTrigger syntax.

table.name: wordAnimationEnd
table.description: Scroll position where every piece is fully revealed in scrub mode. Text near the end of the page still finishes.

table.description: Extra class names for the heading.

table.name: textClassName
table.description: Extra class names for the text.

table.name: scaleWithVelocity
table.description: How much the rows stretch taller at full speed, as a fraction of their height. Negative values squash them instead.

table.description: Lets you grab a row to scrub it, then throw it to glide on with inertia.

table.name: outlineAlternate
table.description: Draws every other row as outlined text.

table.name: gap
table.description: Extra space between the repeated copies in pixels, split evenly around the separator.

table.name: className
table.description: CSS class applied to each text copy (span).

table.name: damping

table.name: stiffness
table.description: Stiffness value for the spring animation.

table.name: numCopies
table.description: Number of copies of the text rendered for a continuous scrolling effect.

table.name: separator
table.description: Shown between the repeated copies, like a dot or a slash. Empty leaves just a space.

table.name: fadeEdges

table.name: pauseOnHover
table.description: Glides the rows to a stop while the pointer is over them.

table.name: velocityMapping
table.description: Mapping from scroll velocity to a movement multiplier for dynamic scrolling.

table.name: color
table.description: Base color of the text.

table.name: shineColor
table.description: Color of the light passing over it.

table.name: speed
table.description: Seconds for one sweep across the text.

table.name: delay
table.description: Seconds of rest between sweeps.

table.name: angle
table.description: Tilt of the band of light in degrees. 90 is upright, higher leans it forward.

table.name: shineWidth
table.description: How wide the band of light is, as a percentage of the text.

table.name: softness
table.description: How gently the band fades at its edges, from 0 for a crisp glint to 1 for a soft sheen.

table.name: bands
table.description: How many bands of light follow each other, like reflections sliding across chrome.

table.name: glow
table.description: A soft bloom of light that travels with the band, from 0 to 1.

table.name: direction
table.description: Which way the light travels.

table.name: easing
table.description: Feel of each sweep. Smooth glides in and out, linear keeps an even pace and snappy flashes across with a pause between.

table.description: When it shines: on a loop, once each time the pointer enters, or once when scrolled into view.

table.name: yoyo
table.description: Sweeps back and forth instead of always starting from the same side.

table.name: followPointer
table.description: While hovered, the light glides after the pointer, then slides off when it leaves.

table.name: pauseOnHover
table.description: Freezes the sweep while the pointer is over the text.

table.description: Shows plain text with no shine.

table.description: Additional class names to style the component.

table.name: text
table.description: A sentence, or a list of sentences typed one after another.

table.name: as
table.description: The element to render, such as h1 or span.

table.name: prefix
table.description: Static text shown before the typed part, such as "We build " in front of rotating words.

table.name: prefixColor
table.description: Color of the prefix. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

table.name: typingSpeed
table.description: Delay between typed characters, in ms.

table.name: initialDelay
table.description: Wait before a sentence starts typing, in ms.

table.name: pauseDuration
table.description: How long a finished sentence stays before it is cleared, in ms.

table.name: deletingSpeed
table.description: Delay between deleted characters, in ms. In select mode, how fast the highlight grows.

table.name: deleteMode
table.description: How a sentence is cleared: erased one character at a time, or highlighted like selected text and then removed at once.

table.name: typeEffect
table.description: How each character appears as it is typed: instantly, fading in, sharpening from a blur, or rising into place.

table.name: mistakes
table.description: From 0 to 1. How often a wrong key is hit. The typo is noticed after a beat, erased, and corrected, like a person typing.

table.name: variableSpeed
table.description: Types each character after a random delay between min and max ms, for a human feel.

table.name: loop
table.description: Starts over after the last sentence. When off, the last sentence stays.

table.name: showCursor
table.description: Shows a blinking cursor at the typing position.

table.name: cursorStyle
table.description: Shape of the cursor. Bar, block and underscore are drawn to fit the font. Character uses cursorCharacter.

table.name: cursorCharacter
table.description: Character or React node used as the cursor when cursorStyle is character.

table.name: cursorColor
table.description: Color of the cursor. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

table.name: cursorBlinkDuration
table.description: Half the length of one blink, in seconds. The cursor fades softly and stays solid while typing.

table.name: cursorGlide
table.description: Glides the cursor smoothly to each new position instead of jumping.

table.name: hideCursorWhileTyping
table.description: Fades the cursor out while characters are being typed or cleared.

table.name: cursorClassName
table.description: Extra class names for the cursor.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the root element.

table.name: textColors
table.description: Colors for the sentences, used in turn.

table.name: onSentenceComplete
table.description: Called with the sentence and its index each time a sentence is cleared.

table.name: startOnVisible
table.description: Waits until the text scrolls into view before typing.

table.name: reverseMode
table.description: Reveals each sentence from its last character back to its first.

name: TrueFocus
description: Applies dynamic blur / clarity based over a series of words in order.

table.name: sentence
table.description: The text to display with the focus animation.

table.name: separator
table.description: String used to split the sentence into words.

table.name: focusStyle
table.description: How the focused word is marked: corner brackets, a full outline, a bar underneath, or a soft filled block behind the word.

table.name: borderColor
table.description: Color of the brackets, box or underline.

table.name: highlightColor
table.description: Color of the block in the highlight style, drawn softly so the text stays readable. Uses the border color when not set.

table.name: glowColor
table.description: Color of a soft glow around the brackets, box or underline. No glow by default.

table.name: focusScale
table.description: Scales up the focused word, for example 1.06. The frame grows with it.

table.name: blurAmount
table.description: Blur on the words that are out of focus, in px.

table.name: unfocusedOpacity
table.description: Opacity of the words that are out of focus, from 0 to 1.

table.name: easing
table.description: How the frame moves between words: a smooth glide, or a spring that slightly overshoots and settles.

table.name: order
table.description: Moves the focus to the next word in reading order, or to a random other word.

table.name: manualMode
table.description: Moves the focus to the hovered word instead of cycling on its own.

table.name: animationDuration
table.description: How long the frame takes to move to the next word, in seconds.

table.name: pauseBetweenAnimations
table.description: How long the focus rests on each word before moving on, in seconds.

table.name: cornerSize
table.description: Length of each corner bracket, in px.

table.name: borderWidth
table.description: Thickness of the brackets, box or underline, in px.

name: VariableProximity
description: Letter styling changes continuously with pointer distance mapping.

table.name: label
table.description: The text content to display.

table.name: fromFontVariationSettings
table.description: The variation settings letters rest at, away from the cursor.

table.name: toFontVariationSettings
table.description: The variation settings to reach at cursor proximity.

table.name: containerRef
table.description: Optional element around the text. Letters skip their distance checks while the cursor is farther than the radius from it.

table.name: radius
table.description: Proximity radius to influence the effect.

table.name: falloff
table.description: Type of falloff for the effect.

table.name: smoothing
table.description: How gently letters ease toward their new settings, from 0 (instant) to 1 (a slow, trailing wake).

table.name: fromColor
table.description: Color letters rest at. Leave unset to keep the text color.

table.name: toColor
table.description: Color letters shift toward as the cursor gets close. Leave unset to keep the text color.

table.name: scale
table.description: Size a letter grows to right under the cursor. 1 keeps letters at their normal size.

table.name: lift
table.description: How far, in em, a letter right under the cursor rises.

table.name: idleWave
table.description: While the cursor is away, a gentle wave of weight travels across the text. It fades out as the cursor comes near.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: Font size of the text. Numbers are pixels. Inherits the surrounding size when unset.

props.label: Hover me! And then star React Bits on GitHub, or else...

name: Shuffle
description: Animated text reveal where characters shuffle before settling.

table.name: text
table.description: The text content to shuffle.

table.name: className
table.description: Optional CSS class for the wrapper element.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles applied to the wrapper element.

table.name: effect
table.description: How each letter cycles: a reel that slides past, a card that flips in 3D through random glyphs, or glyphs that spin in place with motion blur and settle sharp.

table.name: shuffleDirection
table.description: Direction letters travel. Flip turns around the matching axis.

table.name: duration
table.description: Duration (s) of each letter’s shuffle.

table.name: maxDelay
table.description: Longest random delay (s) before a letter starts, when animationMode is "random".

table.name: ease
table.description: GSAP ease for the motion and color shift. Back eases make letters overshoot as they land.

table.name: threshold
table.description: Portion of the element that must enter view before starting.

table.name: rootMargin
table.description: ScrollTrigger start offset (px, %, etc.).

table.name: tag
table.description: HTML tag to render for the text container.

table.name: textAlign
table.description: Text alignment applied via inline style.

table.name: onShuffleComplete
table.description: Called after a full run completes (and on each loop repeat).

table.name: shuffleTimes
table.description: How many interim glyphs each letter passes through before it lands.

table.name: animationMode
table.description: Order the letters start in: odd letters then even ones, left to right, outward from the middle, or after random delays.

table.name: loop
table.description: Repeat the shuffle indefinitely.

table.name: loopDelay
table.description: Delay (s) between loop repeats.

table.name: stagger
table.description: Delay (s) between letters starting, in every mode except "random".

table.name: scrambleCharset
table.description: Characters to use for interim scrambles; empty keeps original copies.

table.name: motionBlur
table.description: Smears the sliding reel along its direction while it moves fast, then lands sharp. Slide effect only.

table.name: color
table.description: Text color. Follows the surrounding text color when unset.

table.name: accentColor
table.description: Color of the interim glyphs while letters are in flight. Settled letters keep the text color.

table.name: colorFrom
table.description: Color each letter starts in, fading to its final color as it lands.

table.name: colorTo
table.description: Color each letter fades to as it lands, and keeps afterwards.

table.name: triggerOnce
table.description: Auto-run only on first scroll into view.

table.name: respectReducedMotion
table.description: Shows the text right away, without shuffling, if the user prefers reduced motion.

table.name: triggerOnHover
table.description: Allow re-playing the animation on hover after it completes.

table.name: hoverRadius
table.description: With hover replay on, only letters within this distance (px) of the cursor reshuffle, closer ones longer and through more glyphs. 0 replays the whole text.

name: ParticleText
description: Text assembles from drifting particles that scatter and reform on demand.

table.name: text
table.description: The words sampled into particle targets.

table.name: color
table.description: Particle color at rest. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

table.name: highlightColor
table.description: Color particles take on while they fly in or get pushed around. Also colors the glow and the scan line.

table.name: intro
table.description: How the text forms. Gather pulls scattered particles together, rain drops them in from above, spiral swirls them into place, and scan assembles the text behind a sweeping line.

table.name: gatherDuration
table.description: Milliseconds for the intro to form the text.

table.name: stagger
table.description: Maximum per-particle delay in milliseconds before it starts moving.

table.name: scatter
table.description: How far particles begin from their final spots in the gather and spiral intros.

table.name: trigger
table.description: When the intro plays again after the first formation: never, on hover, or on click.

table.name: clickBurst
table.description: Clicking blows the particles away from the click point, then they spring back into the text. Off while trigger is click.

table.name: burstStrength
table.description: How hard and how wide a click burst pushes.

table.name: pointerRepel
table.description: Strength of the cursor pushback.

table.name: repelRadius
table.description: Cursor influence radius in pixels.

table.name: idleDrift
table.description: Subtle resting motion after the text has formed.

table.name: shape
table.description: How each particle is drawn. Line draws short strokes that stretch along their motion and settle into an even hatch.

table.name: highlightMode
table.description: Motion lights up particles while they are away from their spot and cools them as they land. Gradient blends the highlight across the text from left to right.

table.name: particleSize
table.description: Rendered size of each particle in CSS pixels.

table.name: density
table.description: Pixel sampling step for the offscreen glyph canvas. Lower values create more particles.

table.name: glow
table.description: Adds a soft bloom in the highlight color around highlighted particles.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: Canvas text size used for glyph sampling.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Font weight used for sampling.

table.name: fontFamily
table.description: Font family used for sampling. Inherit waits for the surrounding font before sampling.

table.name: className
table.description: Optional wrapper class name.

table.name: style
table.description: Optional inline styles for the wrapper.

name: SplitFlapText
description: Mechanical split-flap departure board that clacks through to each new phrase.

table.name: words
table.description: Phrases to cycle through like a departure board.

table.name: text
table.description: Optional single phrase. When set, it takes precedence over words, and changing it flips the board.

table.name: flipDuration
table.description: Duration, in seconds, of each individual flap turn.

table.name: stagger
table.description: Delay, in seconds, between each tile starting its cascade.

table.name: cycleDelay
table.description: Hold time, in milliseconds, before cycling to the next phrase.

table.name: charset
table.description: Characters used for the intermediate flip glyphs.

table.name: flipsPerChar
table.description: Number of intermediate glyphs each changed tile flips through.

table.name: align
table.description: Where phrases shorter than the board sit on it.

table.name: tileColor
table.description: Base color of each mechanical tile.

table.name: textColor
table.description: Color of the glyphs on every flap. "currentColor" follows the surrounding text, handy for the minimal style.

table.name: tileRadius
table.description: Corner radius for each tile.

table.name: gap
table.description: Space between adjacent flap tiles.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: Tile type size. Numeric values are treated as pixels.

table.name: loop
table.description: Whether the phrase array repeats after the final phrase.

table.name: padTo
table.description: Fixed tile count used to keep the board width stable.

table.name: intro
table.description: Starts the board blank and flips it to the first phrase on mount.

table.name: order
table.description: Where the cascade starts: from the left, from the right, out from the middle, or in a random order.

table.name: tileStyle
table.description: Mechanical tiles, or bare characters that flip on their own, split by a hinge line.

table.name: glare
table.description: Strength, from 0 to 1, of the soft light sheen that sweeps down each tile as its flap falls.

table.name: depth
table.description: How physical the board feels, from 0 (flat) to 1: hinge shadow, flap shading as it turns, the shadow a falling flap casts and the thickness of its edge.

table.name: className
table.description: Optional class name for custom styling.

table.name: style
table.description: Optional inline styles for the root element.

name: WarpText
description: WebGL warp that bends and refracts the text around the pointer.

table.name: text
table.description: The headline text rendered into the WebGL texture. Use \n for line breaks.

table.name: color
table.description: Text fill color before the glass refraction pass. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

table.name: warpStrength
table.description: Amount of ambient glass distortion at rest.

table.name: warpScale
table.description: Size of the moving distortion cells.

table.name: speed
table.description: Speed of the ambient undulation.

table.name: lens
table.description: How the cursor bends the text: magnify it, pull it inward or twist it around the pointer.

table.name: pointerInfluence
table.description: Radius of the cursor lensing area.

table.name: pointerStrength
table.description: Strength of cursor-driven bending and magnification.

table.name: idleDrift
table.description: How strongly the lens keeps wandering over the text while the cursor is away, from 0 (it fades out) to 1 (a full-strength lens roaming across the words).

table.name: chromatic
table.description: Color fringing inside the lens and click ripples, like light splitting through real glass. 0 is off, 1 is strong.

table.name: refraction
table.description: Subtle RGB channel split for the glass edge.

table.name: ripple
table.description: Adds a soft ripple to the pointer lens.

table.name: clickRipple
table.description: Clicking sends a shockwave ring through the text that bends the letters as it passes and fades out.

table.name: intro
table.description: Fades the text in from a strong warp that settles once it first comes into view.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: Canvas raster font size. Numbers are pixels. The text shrinks to fit the container.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Font weight used when rasterising the text texture.

table.name: fontFamily
table.description: Font family used when rasterising the text texture.

table.name: letterSpacing
table.description: Tracking applied while drawing the text into the texture.

table.name: lineHeight
table.description: Line height for multi-line text.

table.name: className
table.description: Optional class name for the root element.

table.name: style
table.description: Optional inline styles for sizing or layout.

name: TechText
description: A wordmark whose letters turn into dashed vector paths under the cursor.

table.name: text
table.description: The wordmark to render.

table.name: fontFamily
table.description: Any font family loaded on the page. Leave empty to inherit the font of the container.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Weight of the wordmark.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: Largest font size in px. The wordmark shrinks to fit narrower containers.

table.name: letterSpacing
table.description: Extra space between letters, in em.

table.name: align
table.description: Where the wordmark sits across the container.

table.name: color
table.description: Colour of the letters and their outlines. Follows the surrounding text colour by default.

table.name: accentColor
table.description: Colour of the selection frame, connector, specks and labels.

table.name: reveal
table.description: Area fades the letters into outlines inside a circle around the pointer. Letter turns only the active letter into its outline. Off keeps every letter solid.

table.name: reach
table.description: Radius around the pointer where the letters turn into vector outlines, in px.

table.name: softness
table.description: How gradually the fill hands over to the outlines. 0 is a hard edge.

table.name: dashLength
table.description: Length of each outline dash, in px.

table.name: dashGap
table.description: Space between outline dashes, in px.

table.name: lineStyle
table.description: How the outlines under the pointer are drawn. Only the outer silhouette is traced either way.

table.name: strokeWidth
table.description: Thickness of the outline, in px.

table.name: specks
table.description: Tiny squares that blink and respawn around the active letter, seeded per letter. 0 turns them off.

table.name: selection
table.description: Frame the letter under the pointer. The frame glides from letter to letter.

table.name: labels
table.description: Label the frame with the letter and its size, or with its offset while dragged.

table.name: draggable
table.description: Let letters be dragged off the baseline. They spring back home on release.

table.name: bounce
table.description: How much a released letter overshoots on its way home, from 0 (none) to 1 (very springy).

table.name: clickKick
table.description: Clicking a letter kicks it upward on its spring and sends a ripple through its neighbours, each leaving its outline behind while it moves.

table.name: intro
table.description: Entrance played once the wordmark is in view. Type places each letter as an outline under the selection frame, assemble flies pixel specks into the letters, metrics rules the font lines first and fills the letters zone by zone between them.

table.name: introDuration
table.description: Length of the intro, in seconds.

table.name: guides
table.description: Rule the baseline, x-height, cap height and descender across the wordmark while a letter is active.

table.name: sweep
table.description: Sweep the reveal across the wordmark on its own while the pointer is away.

table.name: speed
table.description: Speed of the idle sweep.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra classes on the container.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles on the container.

name: StrokeText
description: Outlined letterforms draw themselves on, then flood with fill.

table.name: text
table.description: The heading copy rendered as measured SVG glyphs.

table.name: strokeColor
table.description: Color used for the drawing outline.

table.name: fillColor
table.description: Color that floods into the glyphs after the outline draw. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

table.name: strokeWidth
table.description: Width of the SVG text outline.

table.name: drawDuration
table.description: Seconds each character outline spends drawing on.

table.name: fillDelay
table.description: Seconds to wait after the outline draw before the fill begins.

table.name: stagger
table.description: Delay in seconds between each character animation.

table.name: ease
table.description: GSAP easing used for the outline draw.

table.name: trigger
table.description: Chooses when the draw timeline starts. Loop draws on, then plays back out before drawing again.

table.name: fillMode
table.description: Controls whether fill appears with a fade, a directional wipe, or not at all.

table.name: wipeFrom
table.description: Side the wipe fill sweeps in from. Bottom fills the letters like liquid rising.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: Largest font size in px. The wordmark scales down to fit narrower containers.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Weight of the rendered letterforms.

table.name: fontFamily
table.description: Font family of the letterforms. Inherits the surrounding font by default.

table.name: letterSpacing
table.description: Tracking in px applied during measurement and rendering.

table.name: reverse
table.description: Draws the stagger from the final character back to the first.

table.name: strokeStyle
table.description: Line style of the outline. Dashed and dotted outlines still draw on along each letter.

table.name: dashLength
table.description: Length of each dash in px, or the distance between dots for a dotted outline.

table.name: marching
table.description: Keeps dashes or dots flowing around the letters once they are drawn.

table.name: hoverRedraw
table.description: Fades the outline out and draws it again whenever the pointer enters, after the first draw.

table.name: shadow
table.description: Adds a soft offset shadow under the filled letters that lifts into place as the fill lands.

table.name: shadowColor
table.description: Color of the shadow. Uses the stroke color when left unset.

table.name: className
table.description: Optional class applied to the root wrapper.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles passed to the root wrapper.

name: DepthText
description: Layered extruded type with parallax that shifts against the pointer.

table.name: text
table.description: The word or short phrase rendered as extruded type.

table.name: layers
table.description: Number of stacked copies that form the extrusion. Clamped to protect the DOM.

table.name: depth
table.description: Spacing in pixels between each layer of the extrusion.

table.name: faceColor
table.description: Color of the crisp front face. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

table.name: depthColor
table.description: Tint the extrusion fades into toward the back.

table.name: gradientDepth
table.description: Paints the extrusion in the depth color right behind the face and fades it out to the background toward the back.

table.name: tilt
table.description: Resting angle and maximum pointer-driven rotation, in degrees.

table.name: pointerTracking
table.description: Enables smoothed pointer parallax on fine pointer devices.

table.name: smoothing
table.description: Damping amount used to ease rotation toward the pointer target.

table.name: perspective
table.description: Perspective distance in pixels for the 3D stack.

table.name: autoOrbit
table.description: Adds a subtle orbit when pointer tracking is unavailable or idle.

table.name: orbitSpeed
table.description: Speed of the fallback orbit in cycles per second.

table.name: hoverPush
table.description: How far hovering presses the text into the page, from 0 to 1. The extrusion compresses on a spring, pressing pushes a little deeper and releasing bounces back. 0 turns it off.

table.name: float
table.description: Lets the text bob and sway gently while it is not hovered.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: CSS font-size value for the display word.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Font weight used for every layer.

table.name: shadow
table.description: Casts a soft drop shadow behind the extrusion.

table.name: outline
table.description: Draws the extrusion as stacked outlines instead of solid layers.

table.name: intro
table.description: Grows the extrusion out from the flat face on mount.

table.name: className
table.description: Optional class name for the outer wrapper.

table.name: style
table.description: Optional inline styles for the outer wrapper.

name: FoldText
description: Lines unfold into place like creased paper opening flat.

table.name: text
table.description: The text to split and fold into place. Line breaks are kept.

table.name: foldStyle
table.description: How each piece folds. Paper swings open from its hinge edge, blinds splits it into two slats that turn open one after the other, and flip turns it over like a card, lifting toward you mid-turn.

table.name: splitBy
table.description: Whether each character, word or line folds as its own panel.

table.name: hinge
table.description: The edge each panel folds around. For blinds and flip it picks the axis and the turning direction.

table.name: foldAngle
table.description: How far the panels start folded away, in degrees. Past 90 they flip over from behind. Flip always turns a full half turn.

table.name: duration
table.description: How long each panel takes to unfold, in seconds.

table.name: stagger
table.description: Delay between panels, in seconds.

table.name: staggerFrom
table.description: Where the cascade starts.

table.name: ease
table.description: GSAP ease used for the unfold.

table.name: perspective
table.description: Camera distance for the fold, in px. Lower values look deeper.

table.name: creaseShading
table.description: How dark the crease shading gets while a panel is folded, from 0 to 1.

table.name: trigger
table.description: When the text unfolds. Loop holds the text, folds it back up and plays again.

table.name: loopDelay
table.description: How long the unfolded text holds before folding back up, in seconds. Only applies when trigger is 'loop'.

table.name: hoverRefold
table.description: Panels near the cursor fold partly away and ease back open once it passes.

table.name: refoldRadius
table.description: How far from the cursor panels react with hoverRefold, in px. The fold fades out toward the edge.

table.name: refoldAngle
table.description: How far a panel right under the cursor folds away with hoverRefold, in degrees.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: Font size of the text. Numbers are in px.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Font weight of the text.

table.name: color
table.description: Color of the text. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the root element.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the root element.

name: EchoText
description: Ghosted copies trail behind the text and settle into a single word.

table.name: text
table.description: Text rendered by the crisp front copy and every echo.

table.name: echoes
table.description: Number of ghost copies behind the front text, up to 24.

table.name: lag
table.description: How slowly deeper echoes catch up with the text, and how far apart they spread along the auto trail.

table.name: offset
table.description: How far the echoes spread on entrance, how far the text leans toward the cursor and how wide the drift and click burst reach, in px.

table.name: direction
table.description: Direction the entrance trail settles in from.

table.name: fade
table.description: How much of its opacity each echo keeps from the one in front of it.

table.name: blur
table.description: Blur on the deepest echo, in px. Echoes in between blur less.

table.name: tint
table.description: Color blended into the echoes, stronger toward the back. Pass false for plain echoes.

table.name: echoColors
table.description: Two colors the echoes fade between, from the echo nearest the text to the deepest one. Replaces the tint when set.

table.name: echoStyle
table.description: Draws the echoes as filled text or as thin outlines.

table.name: echoScale
table.description: Size of the deepest echo relative to the text. Below 1 the trail recedes, above 1 it looms.

table.name: mode
table.description: Whether the echoes play on entrance, run the live trail, or both. "pointer" means trail only, whatever drives it.

table.name: trail
table.description: What drives the live trail. Pointer follows the cursor, auto drifts the echoes on a slow figure-eight whenever the cursor is away, scroll stretches them behind the text as the page scrolls.

table.name: clickBurst
table.description: Clicking the text releases a burst of echoes that expand from the click point and fade.

table.name: cursorRadius
table.description: Distance in px over which the cursor pulls the text to full offset. With the auto trail, the drift resumes once the cursor leaves this radius.

table.name: duration
table.description: How long the entrance takes to settle, in ms.

table.name: ease
table.description: Timing curve of the entrance.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: Font size of the text.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Font weight of the text.

table.name: color
table.description: Color of the front copy. Follows the surrounding text color by default.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the root element.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the root element.

name: MaskedHeading
description: A headline with a drifting colour mesh or image showing through, revealed word by word.

table.name: text
table.description: Heading copy.

table.name: tag
table.description: Element the heading renders as, so it can carry the right semantics.

table.name: mediaType
table.description: Whether the source showing through the letters is an image or a looping muted video. Videos stay paused for people who prefer reduced motion.

table.name: src
table.description: Image or video URL.

table.name: poster
table.description: Poster frame used while a video loads.

table.name: reveal
table.description: Entrance style: words rise into place, letters grow in one after another, the letters draw together while the heading pulls into focus, a wipe sweeps across, or the whole block fades up.

table.name: trigger
table.description: When the entrance runs.

table.name: duration

table.name: className
table.description: Extra classes on the container.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles on the container.

items.alt: A figure on a white set
items.title: White Room

name: DepthCarousel
description: Cards recede into depth on a 3D rail, with drag, keyboard and auto-advance.

table.name: items
table.description: Slides to display. Pass image URLs or objects with an image URL and alt text.

table.name: cardWidth
table.description: Width of each card in pixels.

table.name: cardHeight
table.description: Height of each card in pixels.

table.name: radius
table.description: Corner rounding of the cards in pixels.

table.name: tint
table.description: Colour multiplied over cards as they recede, shading the depth of the stack.

table.name: depth
table.description: Z distance in pixels between each card along the depth rail. Higher values push the stack further back.

table.name: spread
table.description: Lateral offset in pixels applied per card so the stack fans out to one side.

table.name: tilt
table.description: Degrees each receding card rotates around the vertical axis, revealing its edge.

table.name: tiltDirection
table.description: Which side the stack fans and tilts toward.

table.name: perspective
table.description: CSS perspective in pixels. Lower values exaggerate the depth foreshortening.

table.name: visibleCards
table.description: How many cards deep remain visible before further ones fade out.

table.name: falloff
table.description: How quickly brightness, tint and blur ramp up with depth.

table.name: blur
table.description: Maximum blur in pixels applied to the furthest visible card.

table.name: duration
table.description: Length of the advance transition in milliseconds.

table.name: ease
table.description: GSAP easing used for navigation transitions.

table.name: autoplay
table.description: Auto-advance the carousel, pausing on hover or focus.

table.name: autoplayDelay
table.description: Delay between auto-advances in milliseconds.

table.name: loop
table.description: Wrap seamlessly from the last card back to the first.

table.name: showControls
table.description: Show the previous / next arrow buttons.

table.name: showIndicators
table.description: Show the dot indicators.

table.name: onChange
table.description: Called whenever the focused card changes.

name: AccordionGallery
description: Panels expand on hover or focus, revealing parallax imagery and captions.

table.name: items
table.type: Array<{ image: string; label?: string; link?: string; alt?: string }>
table.description: The panels to render. Each needs an image, and optionally a label, link and alt text.

table.name: defaultIndex
table.description: Index of the panel that is expanded on load, so the gallery never looks dead.

table.name: accentColor
table.description: Colour of the caption accent bar and the focus ring.

table.name: overlayColor
table.description: Colour used for the bottom legibility gradient and the dimming of collapsed panels.

table.name: textColor
table.description: Colour of the caption text.

table.name: grayscale
table.description: Desaturate collapsed panels and restore full colour on the expanded one.

table.name: showLabels
table.description: Whether captions reveal on the expanded panel.

table.name: duration
table.description: Duration of the expand / collapse transition in seconds.

table.name: ease
table.description: GSAP easing used for every transition.

table.name: parallax
table.description: Strength of the internal image drift as panels resize (0 disables it).

table.name: tilt
table.description: Degrees of 3D rotation applied to collapsed panels, easing to flat on the open one.

table.name: stagger
table.description: Delay between the caption bar and text reveal, in seconds.

table.name: trigger
table.description: How a panel expands on pointer devices. Focus and tap always expand too.

table.name: height
table.description: Height of the row in pixels (width of the column when vertical).

table.name: gap
table.description: Gap between panels in pixels.

table.name: radius
table.description: Corner radius of each panel in pixels.

table.name: expandRatio
table.description: Fraction of the row the expanded panel occupies (0.2 – 0.9).

table.name: orientation
table.description: Lay the accordion out as a row or a column.

name: MorphSlider
description: WebGL slider that melts between images with a displacement transition.

table.name: items
table.description: Slides to morph between. Each item is an image URL with an optional caption.

table.name: startIndex
table.description: Index of the slide shown on mount.

table.name: transition
table.description: Character of the GPU displacement morph between slides.

table.name: duration
table.description: Length of a full transition in seconds.

table.name: ease
table.description: GSAP easing curve used to drive the transition progress.

table.name: intensity
table.description: Strength of the displacement — how far the images warp during the morph.

table.name: scale
table.description: Frequency of the procedural noise field (affects the Melt transition most).

table.name: aberration
table.description: Amount of RGB split that peaks mid-transition and resolves to zero.

table.name: drift
table.description: Idle drift / breathing applied to the current image so it is never fully static.

table.name: autoplay
table.description: Advance slides automatically; pauses on hover.

table.name: autoplayDelay
table.description: Seconds each slide holds before autoplay advances.

table.name: loop
table.description: Wrap around from the last slide back to the first.

table.name: radius
table.description: Corner radius of the slider in pixels.

table.name: overlayColor
table.description: Tint used for the subtle edge vignette over the images.

table.name: showCaptions
table.description: Show slide captions that animate in with each transition.

table.name: showControls
table.description: Show the previous / next arrow buttons.

table.name: showIndicators
table.description: Show the slide indicator dots.

table.name: className
table.description: Additional CSS classes for the outer wrapper.

name: DriftWall
description: An endless perspective wall of tiles drifting past, lifting on hover.

table.name: items
table.description: Tiles to display. Each item has { image, title?, href? }.

table.name: columns
table.description: Number of drifting columns.

table.name: tileWidth
table.description: Width of each tile in pixels.

table.name: tileHeight
table.description: Height of each tile in pixels.

table.name: gap
table.description: Spacing between tiles and columns in pixels.

table.name: radius
table.description: Corner radius of each tile in pixels.

table.name: tilt
table.description: Perspective pitch of the wall (rotateX, degrees).

table.name: turn
table.description: Perspective yaw of the wall (rotateY, degrees).

table.name: roll
table.description: In-plane rotation of the wall (rotateZ, degrees).

table.name: perspective
table.description: Perspective distance in pixels — smaller is more dramatic.

table.name: depth
table.description: How far the wall sits back from the viewer in pixels.

table.name: speed
table.description: Base drift speed in pixels per second.

table.name: direction
table.description: Primary drift direction; columns alternate around it.

table.name: variance
table.description: How much column speeds differ from each other (0–1).

table.name: parallax
table.description: Pointer-follow tilt strength (0 disables it).

table.name: pauseOnHover
table.description: Pause the whole wall while the pointer is over it.

table.name: lift
table.description: How far a hovered tile lifts toward the viewer in pixels.

table.name: fade
table.description: Strength of the edge and depth dissolve (0–1).

table.name: dim
table.description: Resting opacity of unhovered tiles (0–1).

table.name: grayscale
table.description: Desaturate resting tiles; hover restores colour.

table.name: overlayColor
table.description: Tint laid over resting tiles, cleared on hover.

name: CircularGallery
description: A curved image gallery you can drag, scroll or tab through, with cards that open to the full image.

table.name: items
table.type: Array<{ image: string; text?: string; description?: string; alt?: string }>
table.description: Images to show. `text` is the title under each card, `description` appears under the title when a card is open and `alt` names the image for screen readers.

table.name: bend
table.description: Curvature of the arc. Positive values arch the cards down at the edges, negative values lift them, 0 lays them flat.

table.name: itemSize
table.description: Card height relative to the container, from 0.2 to 2.

table.name: itemAspect
table.description: Card width divided by height. Images are cropped to fill the card.

table.name: gap
table.description: Space between cards as a fraction of the card width.

table.name: borderRadius
table.description: Corner radius as a fraction of the card size, from 0 (square) to 0.5 (fully round).

table.name: wave
table.description: How much the cards ripple while the gallery moves. 0 keeps them flat.

table.name: fadeEdges
table.description: Fades the cards out toward the left and right edges, from 0 to 0.5 of the width.

table.name: shadow
table.description: Strength of the soft shadow under each card.

table.name: textColor
table.description: Color of the titles, the keyboard focus ring and the placeholder shown while images load.

table.name: font
table.description: CSS font shorthand for the titles. The size scales with the cards, so 30px means the default size and larger values make the titles bigger.

table.name: fontUrl
table.description: Font to load for the titles. Accepts a stylesheet URL (e.g. a Google Fonts link) or a font file (.woff2, .woff, .ttf, .otf). The loaded family replaces the family in `font`.

table.name: showTitles
table.description: Shows the title of each card underneath it.

table.name: scrollSpeed
table.description: How far the gallery travels per drag or wheel movement.

table.name: scrollEase
table.description: How quickly the gallery catches up with the input, from 0.001 (floaty) to 1 (instant).

table.name: snap
table.description: Settles on the nearest card after dragging or scrolling.

table.name: autoScroll
table.description: Speed of an automatic drift, where 1 moves about one card every four seconds and negative values drift the other way. It pauses on hover, while dragging, while a card is open and briefly after any input.

table.name: grayscale
table.description: Shows the images in grayscale and brings the color back on hover, focus or when opened.

table.name: openOnClick
table.description: Clicking a card opens it to its full image. Click it again, click outside it, press Escape or use the close button to return. When off, clicking a card centers it.

table.name: intro
table.description: Glides the cards in when the gallery mounts.

table.name: onItemClick
table.description: Called when a card is clicked.

table.name: onActiveChange
table.description: Called when a different card becomes the centered one.

table.name: dpr
table.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the container.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the container.

name: Counter
description: An odometer-style number whose digits roll to every new value, with currency, separators and locales.

table.name: value
table.description: The number to show. Digits roll to every new value.

table.name: locale
table.description: Locale used for separators, symbols and numerals.

table.name: format
table.description: Formatting options such as currency, percent, units or compact notation.

table.name: decimals
table.description: Fixed number of decimal places. Leave it out to use the format defaults.

table.name: minDigits
table.description: Pads the whole part with leading zeros.

table.name: prefix
table.description: Content shown before the number.

table.name: suffix
table.description: Content shown after the number.

table.name: direction
table.description: Which way digits roll. Auto rolls up as the number grows and down as it shrinks.

table.name: duration
table.description: Roughly how long a roll takes, in seconds.

table.name: bounce
table.description: How much digits overshoot before settling, from 0 to 0.9.

table.name: stagger
table.description: Delay in seconds between neighbouring digits, so changes ripple from the right.

table.name: motionBlur
table.description: Blurs digits along their path while they spin fast.

table.name: intro
table.description: Spins every digit once and lands it when the counter first scrolls into view.

table.name: fade
table.description: How far in em digits roll beyond the text before fading out. 0 clips them at the edge.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: Font size in px, or any CSS size such as inherit.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Font weight of the number.

table.name: textColor
table.description: Color of the number.

table.name: gap
table.description: Space between digits and symbols in px.

table.name: padding
table.description: Extra height in px added to each digit, which also spaces out rolling digits.

table.name: tabular
table.description: Keeps every digit the same width. When off, widths ease between digits as they roll.

table.name: digitStyle
table.description: Styles for each digit box, for example a tile background with padding and radius.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the root.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the root.

name: DecayCard
description: An image card that tears and melts as the pointer moves, then pulls itself back together.

table.name: image
table.description: Image URL. It fills the card like a cover.

table.name: children
table.description: Content shown over the bottom of the image.

table.name: width
table.description: Card width in pixels.

table.name: height
table.description: Card height in pixels.

table.name: intensity
table.description: How far the image tears apart at full decay, from 0 to 2. The edges tear the most so the photo stays readable.

table.name: sensitivity
table.description: How little pointer movement it takes to reach full decay, from 0 to 1.

table.name: hoverDecay
table.description: Decay that stays while the pointer rests on the card, from 0 to 1.

table.name: recovery
table.description: Seconds the image takes to pull itself back together once the pointer slows down.

table.name: idle
table.description: Keeps the edges slowly fraying and soft patches drifting while nobody interacts, from 0 to 1.

table.name: grain
table.description: Size of the tears, from broad melting shapes at 0 to fine shards at 1.

table.name: detail
table.description: Layers of noise in the tears, from 1 to 8. More layers give rougher edges.

table.name: pattern
table.description: Picks a different tear pattern.

table.name: flow
table.description: Lets the tears churn while the card is decaying. 0 keeps them still.

table.name: chroma
table.description: Splits the color channels apart inside the tears.

table.name: travel
table.description: How far in pixels the card drifts toward the pointer before it slows down.

table.name: tilt
table.description: How far in degrees the card rotates as the pointer moves sideways.

table.name: scope
table.description: Window follows the pointer anywhere on the page. Card only reacts while it is hovered.

table.name: radius
table.description: Corner radius of the image in pixels.

table.name: grayscale
table.description: Shows the image in grayscale.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the root.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the root.

name: Dock
description: macOS style dock with smooth magnification, launch bounce, badges and context menus.

table.name: items
table.description: The apps in the dock. Each item takes an icon, label and onClick, plus optional className, active (an open app, shown with a dot), badge (a number, text, or true for a plain dot) and menu. Add { separator: true } to divide groups.

table.name: items[].menu
table.description: Rows of the context menu that opens on right click, long press or the menu key. Rows take label, onClick, icon, checked, disabled, shortcut and items for a submenu. Add { separator: true } for a divider.

table.name: position
table.description: The edge of the nearest positioned parent the dock sits on. Icons grow away from that edge and the dock stands vertically on the left and right.

table.name: theme
table.description: Colors of the panel, tiles, labels and menus, made for dark or light pages.

table.name: baseItemSize
table.description: Size of each icon at rest, in px. The dock shrinks everything evenly when its parent is too small to fit it.

table.name: magnification
table.description: Size of the icon right under the pointer, in px. Set it to baseItemSize to turn magnifying off.

table.name: distance
table.description: How far from the pointer icons still grow, in px. Larger values spread the swell over more icons.

table.name: panelHeight
table.description: Thickness of the dock bar, in px. Icons rise out of it as they grow.

table.name: gap
table.description: Space between icons, in px.

table.name: roundness
table.description: Corner rounding of the tiles and the bar, from square at 0 to circles at 1.

table.name: spring
table.type: { mass?: number; stiffness?: number; damping?: number }
table.description: The spring icons grow and shrink with. Higher stiffness is faster, and low damping lets icons overshoot and wobble.

table.name: bounce
table.description: Icons hop when clicked, like apps launching on macOS.

table.name: autoHide
table.description: Slides the dock off its edge until the pointer comes near that edge of the parent. It stays out while hovered, focused or showing a menu.

table.name: tiles
table.description: Draws a rounded tile behind each icon. Turn it off for bare glyphs, or when your icons are full app artwork.

table.name: showLabels
table.description: Shows the label of the hovered or focused icon in a tooltip.

table.name: showIndicators
table.description: Shows a dot next to items marked active, like open apps on macOS.

table.name: showBadges
table.description: Shows the notification badges set on items.

table.name: badgeColor
table.description: Fill color of the notification badges.

table.name: accentColor
table.description: Color of the highlighted row in menus and of the keyboard focus ring.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the dock panel.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the dock panel.

name: DomeGallery
description: Immersive 3D dome gallery projecting images on a hemispheric surface.

table.name: images
table.description: Array of image URLs (strings) or image objects with src and optional alt text

table.name: fit
table.description: Size factor for the dome radius based on container dimensions

table.name: fitBasis
table.description: Basis for calculating the dome size

table.name: minRadius
table.description: Minimum radius for the dome in pixels

table.name: maxRadius
table.description: Maximum radius for the dome in pixels

table.name: padFactor
table.description: Padding factor for the viewer area

table.name: overlayBlurColor
table.description: Color for the outer portion of the radial overlay blur

table.name: maxVerticalRotationDeg
table.description: Maximum vertical rotation angle in degrees

table.name: dragSensitivity
table.description: Sensitivity of drag interactions

table.name: enlargeTransitionMs
table.description: Duration of image enlargement transition in milliseconds

table.name: segments
table.description: Number of segments for both X and Y to keep the dome proportional

table.name: dragDampening
table.description: Damping factor for drag inertia (0-1, higher = more damping)

table.name: openedImageWidth
table.description: Width of the enlarged image

table.name: openedImageHeight
table.description: Height of the enlarged image

table.name: imageBorderRadius
table.description: Border radius for closed tile images

table.name: openedImageBorderRadius
table.description: Border radius for opened/enlarged images

table.name: grayscale
table.description: Whether to render all images in grayscale

name: ElasticSlider
description: A slider that grows under your cursor and stretches like rubber when pulled past either end, then springs back.

table.name: value
table.description: Controlled value. Pair it with onChange.

table.name: defaultValue
table.description: Starting value when uncontrolled.

table.name: startingValue
table.description: Lowest value of the range.

table.name: maxValue
table.description: Highest value of the range.

table.name: isStepped
table.description: Snaps the value to stepSize increments.

table.name: stepSize
table.description: Size of each step when isStepped is on.

table.name: onChange
table.description: Called as the value changes.

table.name: onChangeEnd
table.description: Called when a drag, key press or scroll finishes.

table.name: orientation
table.description: Direction of the track. Vertical sliders fill from the bottom.

table.name: leftIcon
table.description: Icon at the start of the track. Pass null to hide it.

table.name: rightIcon
table.description: Icon at the end of the track. Pass null to hide it.

table.name: iconPlacement
table.description: Puts the icons beside the track, or inside it once the track is thick enough to hold them.

table.name: valuePosition
table.description: Where the value shows. Bubble rides above the fill while the slider is active.

table.name: formatValue
table.description: Formats the shown value and the value read by screen readers.

table.name: ticks
table.description: Marks along the track. True marks every step, or every tenth when not stepped. An array marks those values.

table.name: thumb
table.description: Shows a round handle at the end of the fill.

table.name: fillFrom
table.description: Value the fill grows from. Set it to the middle of the range for a centered, two-way fill.

table.name: thickness
table.description: Track thickness in px at rest.

table.name: activeThickness
table.description: Track thickness in px while hovered, focused or dragged.

table.name: radius
table.description: Corner radius of the track in px. Fully round when left out.

table.name: restOpacity
table.description: Opacity while idle. The slider brightens to full when active.

table.name: growOnHover
table.description: Hovering activates the slider. When off it only grows while pressed or focused.

table.name: maxStretch
table.description: Furthest the track stretches in px when pulled past an end. 0 turns the stretch off.

table.name: bounce
table.description: How much the track wobbles as it springs back, from 0 to 0.95.

table.name: jumpToClick
table.description: Pressing the track jumps to the pointer. When off, dragging moves the value from where it was.

table.name: wheel
table.description: Lets the scroll wheel change the value.

table.name: trackColor
table.description: Color of the empty track.

table.name: rangeColor
table.description: Color of the fill.

table.name: iconColor
table.description: Color of the outside icons.

table.name: contentColor
table.description: Color of icons, values and ticks over the empty track.

table.name: fillContentColor
table.description: Color of icons, values and ticks over the fill. Auto picks light or dark from the fill color.

table.name: thumbColor
table.description: Color of the handle.

table.name: disabled
table.description: Turns off interaction and dims the slider.

table.name: ariaLabel
table.description: Accessible name of the slider.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the root.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the root.

name: FlowingMenu
description: A full-height menu with a liquid band that glides between rows and reveals a scrolling marquee of each item.

table.name: items
table.type: Array<{ text, link?, image?, marquee?, meta? }>
table.description: Menu rows. marquee changes the text that scrolls in the band and meta adds a note at the end of the row.

table.name: speed
table.description: Marquee speed in px per second.

table.name: direction
table.description: Which way the marquee runs. Alternate flips every other row.

table.name: followCursor
table.description: How much moving the cursor sideways speeds up or reverses the marquee, from 0 to 1.

table.name: duration
table.description: Time in seconds the band takes to glide to a row.

table.name: stretch
table.description: How much the band stretches like liquid while it moves, from 0 for rigid to 1.

table.name: magnet
table.description: How much the band leans toward the cursor inside a row, from 0 to 1.

table.name: bandInset
table.description: Gap in px between the band and the row edges.

table.name: carryContent
table.description: Moves the marquee with the band instead of keeping it fixed in each row.

table.name: bandRadius
table.description: Corner radius of the band in px. Use a large value for a pill.

table.name: textColor
table.description: Color of the menu text.

table.name: bgColor
table.description: Background color of the menu.

table.name: marqueeBgColor
table.description: Background color of the band.

table.name: marqueeTextColor
table.description: Text color inside the band.

table.name: borderColor
table.description: Color of the lines between rows.

table.name: dividers
table.description: Draws lines between rows.

table.name: dimInactive
table.description: Fades the other rows while the band is on one.

table.name: align
table.description: Alignment of the row labels.

table.name: showIndex
table.description: Numbers each row.

table.name: showArrow
table.description: Adds an arrow to the end of each row.

table.name: imageShape
table.description: Shape of the images in the band.

table.name: intro
table.description: Rows rise in, the lines draw and the band sweeps once down the menu on mount.

table.name: activeIndex
table.description: Marks the current page row.

table.name: onItemClick
table.description: Called when a row is clicked.

table.name: ariaLabel
table.description: Accessible name of the navigation.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the menu.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the menu.

name: FluidGlass
description: A 3D glass object that refracts your headline, image or video, follows the cursor and melts between shapes.

table.name: text
table.description: Headline drawn behind the glass, so the glass can bend it. Use \n for line breaks. It takes the font and color of the container unless you set them.

table.name: src
table.description: Image or video behind the glass. Videos (.mp4, .webm, .mov) play muted on a loop. Files from another site need CORS headers.

table.name: fit
table.description: How the image or video fills the area.

table.name: background
table.description: Color behind the text and media. Transparent lets your page show through.

table.name: textColor
table.description: Color of the text. Defaults to the CSS color.

table.name: fontFamily
table.description: Font of the text. Defaults to the font of the container.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Weight of the text.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: Size of the text in px. By default it scales to fill the width.

table.name: shape
table.description: Shape of the glass. The blob is a drop of liquid glass that keeps rippling. Changing the shape melts the glass smoothly into the new one.

table.name: shapes
table.description: Shapes the glass cycles through when clicked.

table.name: morphOnClick
table.description: Clicking the glass melts it into the next shape.

table.name: size
table.description: Diameter of the glass in px. It shrinks to fit small areas.

table.name: interaction
table.description: How the glass responds: it glides after the cursor, it can be picked up and thrown around, or it stays in place.

table.name: position
table.description: Where the glass rests, as fractions of the width and height.

table.name: refraction
table.description: How strongly the glass bends light, from 0 to 2. Around 0.66 behaves like water.

table.name: dispersion
table.description: How much light splits into rainbow fringes at the edges, from 0 to 1.

table.name: frost
table.description: Frosts the glass so what is behind it blurs, from 0 to 1.

table.name: color
table.description: Color of the glass.

table.name: tint
table.description: How strongly the glass takes on its color. Thicker parts look deeper, like real colored glass.

table.name: reflection
table.description: Strength of the highlights and reflections on the surface, from 0 to 2.

table.name: shadow
table.description: Strength of the shadow and the focused light the glass casts below it, from 0 to 1.

table.name: elevation
table.description: How high the glass floats above the content. Higher magnifies more, until the image flips.

table.name: smoothness
table.description: How lazily the glass follows, from 0 (snappy) to 1 (floaty).

table.name: wobble
table.description: How much the glass stretches when it moves and wobbles when it stops, like a liquid. 0 keeps it rigid.

table.name: spin
table.description: Idle rotation speed for shapes like the cube and the torus. Negative values spin the other way.

table.name: idle
table.description: The glass drifts gently around its resting place while nobody interacts.

table.name: intro
table.description: The glass pops into place on mount.

table.name: maxDevicePixelRatio
table.description: Highest pixel ratio the canvas renders at.

table.name: children
