name: PixelCard
description: A card that fills with twinkling pixels on hover, rippling out from the center or the cursor.

table.name: variant
table.description: A ready-made palette with its own gap and speed. Any prop you pass overrides it.

table.name: colors
table.description: Pixel colors, as an array or a comma-separated string. Each pixel picks one at random.

table.name: glowColor
table.description: Color of the soft light that follows the cursor across the card.

table.name: gap
table.description: Distance between pixels, in px.

table.name: pixelSize
table.description: Largest size a pixel grows to, in px.

table.name: speed
table.description: How fast the pixels twinkle, from 0 to 100. 0 holds them still.

table.name: shape
table.description: Shape of each pixel.

table.name: origin
table.description: Where the reveal wave starts: the middle of the card, or wherever the pointer enters.

table.name: revealDuration
table.description: How long the wave takes to sweep across the card, in ms.

table.name: spotlight
table.description: How much pixels near the cursor swell and brighten, from 0 to 1.

table.name: glow
table.description: Strength of the soft light under the pixels.

table.description: Opacity of the pixels and glow. Lower it to keep text on the card easy to read.

table.name: fade
table.description: Fades the pixels out toward the middle so they frame your content, from 0 to 1.

table.description: What turns the effect on: hovering or focusing the card, clicking it on and off, or always on.

table.name: clickPulse
table.description: Clicking sends a ripple of brighter pixels out from the click.

table.name: intro
table.description: Plays the reveal once when the card first scrolls into view.

table.name: introDelay

table.name: noFocus
table.description: Stops keyboard focus from triggering the effect.

table.name: theme
table.description: Color theme of the card.

table.name: radius
table.description: Corner radius of the card, in px.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the card.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the card.

table.name: children
table.description: Card content. It is centered and sits above the pixels.

name: ProfileCard
description: A framed profile card that tilts toward the cursor, with holographic foil shining through a tiled pattern.

table.name: avatarUrl
table.description: Portrait shown on the card.

table.name: iconUrl
table.description: Tileable pattern, like a logo pattern. The holo foil shows only through it.

table.name: miniAvatarUrl
table.description: Small round image next to the handle. Hidden when not set.

table.name: name

table.name: title

table.name: handle

table.name: status

table.name: statusColor
table.description: Color of the status dot.

table.name: contactText

table.name: showUserInfo
table.description: Shows the footer with the handle, status and contact button.

table.name: onContactClick
table.description: Called when the contact button is clicked.

table.name: theme
table.description: Color theme of the frame and footer.

table.name: backdropColor

table.name: radius
table.description: Corner radius of the photo, in px.

table.name: glare
table.description: Strength of the light that follows the cursor, from 0 to 1.

table.name: tiltStrength

table.name: parallax

table.name: mobileTiltSensitivity

table.name: intro
table.description: Catches the light once as the card appears, then settles.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the card.

name: ScrollStack
description: Cards pin and stack as you scroll, settling back into a dimmed deck with smooth, jitter-free motion.

table.name: children
table.description: The cards to stack, usually ScrollStackItem elements.

table.name: itemDistance
table.description: Gap between cards before they stack, in px. Larger gaps mean more scrolling between cards.

table.name: itemStackDistance
table.description: How far each card rests below the one before it in the stack, in px. 0 piles them exactly.

table.name: stackPosition
table.description: Where the stack pins, from the top of the viewport or container. A number is px, or use a % string.

table.name: itemScale
table.description: How much a card shrinks for each card stacked on top of it.

table.name: baseScale
table.description: The smallest a buried card can shrink to.

table.name: dimAmount
table.description: How much a card darkens for each card stacked on top of it, from 0 to 1.

table.name: blurAmount
table.description: Blur added for each card stacked on top, in px.

table.name: tiltAmount
table.description: How far buried cards lean back in 3D, in degrees.

table.name: rotationAmount
table.description: How far buried cards turn, alternating left and right like a loose pile, in degrees.

table.name: holdDistance
table.description: How long the finished stack stays pinned before it scrolls away, in px of scrolling.

table.name: smoothScroll
table.description: Glides mouse wheel scrolling smoothly. Touch, keyboard and scrollbar scrolling stay native. With useWindowScroll it smooths the whole page while the stack is mounted.

table.name: snap
table.description: When scrolling stops near a card, glides it the rest of the way onto the stack.

table.name: useWindowScroll

table.name: onStackComplete
table.description: Called when the last card lands on the stack.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the stack container.

table.name: itemClassName
table.description: ScrollStackItem only. Extra class names for the card, for its size, colors and content.

table.name: style
table.description: ScrollStackItem only. Inline styles for the card.

table.description: Content of the card.

table.name: spotlightColor
table.description: Color of the light. Any CSS color works and its alpha is respected. Defaults to white on dark cards and near black on light ones.

table.name: intensity
table.description: Brightness of the light on the card surface, from 0 to 1.

table.name: spotlightSize
table.description: Radius of the light in px.

table.name: softness
table.description: How gradually the light fades out. 0 gives a crisp disc, 1 a soft glow that fades from the center.

table.name: shape
table.description: Circle is a round spotlight around the pointer. Beam pours light down from the top edge toward it, like a stage light.

table.name: borderGlow
table.description: How much the card edge catches the light near the pointer, from 0 to 1.

table.name: proximity
table.description: Distance in px outside the card at which the light starts to reach it. Cards placed together share one light this way. 0 lights a card only while hovered.

table.name: smoothing
table.description: How far the light floats behind the pointer. 0 sticks to it.

table.name: ambient
table.description: Lets the light drift slowly across the card while nothing points at it, which keeps cards alive on touch screens.

table.name: flare
table.description: The light swells and brightens while the card is pressed.

table.name: grain
table.description: Film grain inside the light, from 0 to 1. A little removes banding from large soft gradients.

table.name: theme
table.description: Surface, border and light treatment for dark or light pages. Override the colors with the --spotlight-card-surface and --spotlight-card-border CSS variables.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the card.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the card.

table.name: ...rest

table.name: edgeSensitivity

table.name: backgroundColor

table.name: borderRadius
table.description: Corner radius of the card in pixels.

table.name: glowRadius

table.name: glowIntensity

table.name: coneSpread

table.name: colors
table.description: Array of 3 hex colors for the mesh gradient border, distributed across positions.

table.name: textColor

table.name: markerColor

table.name: proximityRadius

table.name: markerLength

table.name: markerGap

table.name: tickScale

table.name: scaleTick

table.name: itemGap
table.description: Vertical gap between items in pixels.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: Font size of the labels in rem.

table.name: smoothing
table.description: Transition duration in milliseconds for the proximity response.

table.name: defaultActive
table.description: Index of the item selected on mount.

table.name: onItemClick
table.description: Called when an item is clicked; the clicked item also becomes active.

table.name: className
table.description: Additional CSS classes for the outer wrapper.

name: OptionWheel

table.description: Labels rendered as the wheel options.

table.name: defaultSelected
table.description: Index of the option selected on mount.

table.description: Called whenever the wheel settles on a new option.

table.name: textColor
table.description: Resting color of the option labels.

table.name: activeColor

table.description: Font size of the option labels in rem.

table.name: spacing

table.name: blur

table.name: minOpacity

table.name: smoothing

table.name: inset

table.description: Additional CSS classes for the outer wrapper.

name: SpecularButton
description: Glass button whose edge catches the light, with a highlight that glides toward the cursor.

table.name: children
table.description: Button label or any content.

table.name: size
table.description: Padding and font size of the button.

table.name: radius
table.description: Corner radius in px. Values past half the height make a pill.

table.name: tint
table.description: Color of the glass body.

table.name: tintOpacity
table.description: How strongly the tint fills the body, from 0 for clear glass to 1 for a solid button.

table.name: blur
table.description: Blur of whatever sits behind the button, in px.

table.name: textColor
table.description: Color of the label.

table.name: lineColor
table.description: Color of the light on the edge.

table.name: baseColor
table.description: Color of the thin edge line that stays visible under the light.

table.name: intensity
table.description: Brightness of the light on the edge.

table.name: idleIntensity
table.description: How much of the light stays on when the cursor is away, from 0 to 1.

table.name: shineSize
table.description: How much of the edge the light covers at full strength, in degrees around the button.

table.name: shineFade
table.description: How far the light fades out past that, in degrees around the button.

table.name: thickness
table.description: Width of the lit edge in px.

table.name: glow
table.description: Soft light around the lit edge and inside the glass. 0 keeps only the crisp line.

table.name: followMouse
table.description: Moves the light to the part of the edge nearest the cursor.

table.name: proximity
table.description: Distance in px at which the light starts to follow the cursor and brighten.

table.name: autoAnimate

table.name: speed
table.description: How fast the light circles when autoAnimate is on.

table.name: disabled
table.description: Disables the button.

table.name: onClick
table.description: Click handler.

table.name: type
table.description: Native button type.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the button.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the button.

table.name: src
table.description: URL of an SVG or PNG to inflate instead of text. Its transparent pixels define the shape.

table.name: fontFamily
table.description: Font used for the text. Heavy, rounded faces inflate best.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Weight of the text.

table.name: color
table.description: Base color of the material.

table.name: imageColors
table.description: Keeps the colors of the image passed to src instead of using color.

table.name: material
table.description: Surface finish: glossy balloon, mirror chrome, glowing jelly or soft matte clay.

table.name: inflate
table.description: How puffy the shape is. 1 gives round tubes.

table.name: stiffness
table.description: How firm the material feels, from 0 for soft and stretchy to 1 for firm and quick.

table.name: wobble
table.description: How long it jiggles after a poke or a pull, from 0 to 1.

table.name: grabRadius
table.description: Size of the area the cursor grabs and presses, in pixels.

table.name: stretch
table.description: How far the material can be pulled, from 0 to 1.

table.name: press
table.description: Depth of the dent under the cursor and of a poke.

table.name: shadow
table.description: Strength of the soft drop shadow.

table.name: intro
table.description: Inflates the shape letter by letter on mount.

table.name: theme
table.description: Lighting setup for dark or light pages.

table.name: dpr
table.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the container.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the container.

description: Pointer-driven water displacement that warps content and leaves a decaying wake.

table.name: src
table.description: Image URL the ripples distort. Cover fitted to the container.

table.name: brushSize
table.description: Diameter of each ripple the pointer lays down, in px.

table.name: strength
table.description: How far the image is pushed, as a fraction of its size.

table.name: swirl
table.description: Full turns the push direction sweeps through as a ripple builds. 0 gives a flat push, higher folds the image into caustics.

table.name: rings
table.description: Concentric swells inside each ripple. 0 is a single plain blob.

table.name: spread
table.description: How many times its own size a ripple grows to before it dies.

table.name: fade
table.description: How long a ripple survives, in seconds.

table.name: spacing
table.description: Pointer travel between ripples, in px. Higher leaves a sparser trail.

table.name: dispersion
table.description: Chromatic split between the red and blue channels as they refract.

table.name: glint
table.description: Sheen riding the shoulders of each ripple.

table.name: tint
table.description: Colour the disturbed water takes on.

table.name: tintAmount
table.description: How strongly the tint colours the disturbed water.

table.name: highlightColor
table.description: Colour of the sheen.

table.name: grayscale
table.description: Drain the colour out of the image so the folds read on tone alone.

table.name: trigger
table.description: What disturbs the surface: motion, clicks, or both.

table.name: clickStrength
table.description: How much larger a click ripple starts than a hover one.

table.name: quality
table.description: Resolution of the displacement buffer. Lower trades crispness for fill rate.

table.name: enabled
table.description: Toggle the effect on or off.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra classes on the container.

table.description: Content the swarm flows behind, such as a hero with buttons.

table.name: count
table.description: Number of particles in the swarm, up to 2000.

table.description: Size of each particle, in px.

table.name: shape
table.description: Shape of each particle.

table.name: color

table.name: accentColor
table.description: Color particles take on when they rush and when you click.

table.name: spread
table.description: Radius of the swarm around the cursor, in px.

table.description: How much the grid lines brighten around the cursor, from 0 to 1.

table.name: cellGap
table.description: Inset of lit cells, in px. Above 0, lit cells become separate tiles.

table.name: cellRadius
table.description: Corner radius of lit tiles, in px.

table.name: clickPulse
table.description: Clicking sends a ring of lit cells out from the click.

table.name: pulseSpeed
table.description: Speed of the click ring, in px per second.

table.name: ambient
table.description: Lets random cells glow softly on their own, from 0 to 1.

table.name: edgeFade
table.description: Fades the grid out toward the edges, from 0 to 0.5.

table.name: intro
table.description: Draws the grid out from the center with a pulse on mount.

table.name: lightMode
table.description: Uses near black lines and cells by default, for light pages.

table.name: children
table.description: Content drawn above the grid. The grid keeps reacting to the cursor underneath it.

table.name: dpr
table.description: Maximum device pixel ratio, capped at 2.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the container.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the container.

name: CurvedInput
description: Arc-bent input bar with text, caret and submit button all following the curve.

table.name: value
table.description: Controlled value; leave undefined for uncontrolled usage.

table.name: defaultValue
table.description: Initial value when the input is uncontrolled.

table.name: onChange
table.description: Called with the new value on every keystroke.

table.name: onSubmit
table.description: Called when the button is pressed or Enter is hit.

table.name: placeholder
table.description: Placeholder text rendered along the curve when empty.

table.name: buttonText
table.description: Label of the curved submit button.

table.name: type
table.description: Semantic input type; email/number map to the matching mobile keyboard.

table.name: name
table.description: Name attribute forwarded to the underlying input.

table.name: ariaLabel
table.description: Accessible label; falls back to the placeholder.

table.name: theme
table.description: Color preset; any explicit color prop overrides its theme value.

table.name: width
table.description: Width of the input bar (pixels or any CSS width value, e.g. "100%").

table.name: bend
table.description: How many pixels the center of the bar arches above its ends; negative bends downward, 0 is flat.

table.name: height
table.description: Thickness of the input bar in pixels.

table.name: cornerRadius
table.description: Corner rounding of the bar; the button rounds proportionally.

table.name: borderWidth
table.description: Outline stroke width in pixels.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: Font size of the curved text and button label.

table.name: backgroundColor
table.description: Fill color of the input bar; overrides the theme.

table.name: textColor
table.description: Color of the typed text and caret; overrides the theme.

table.name: placeholderColor
table.description: Color of the placeholder text; overrides the theme.

table.name: borderColor
table.description: Color of the outline stroke; overrides the theme.

table.name: buttonColor
table.description: Fill of the submit button, the focus ring and the default icon chip; overrides the theme.

table.name: buttonTextColor
table.description: Color of the button label; overrides the theme.

table.name: iconColor
table.description: Fill of the icon chip; defaults to the button color.

table.name: shadowSize
table.description: Size of the soft drop shadow under the bar.

table.name: shadowColor
table.description: Tint of the drop shadow; overrides the theme.

table.name: showButton
table.description: Render the curved submit button.

table.name: showIcon
table.description: Render the leading icon chip.

table.name: icon
table.description: Custom SVG content for the icon, centered at the origin; replaces the default envelope chip.

table.name: className
table.description: Additional CSS classes for the wrapper form.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the wrapper form.

name: Stack
description: Pile of cards you can drag, flick or click through, with thrown cards tucking underneath.

table.name: cards
table.description: The cards in the stack, top first. Images fill the card automatically, any other content works too.

table.name: layout
table.description: How the cards behind sit. Fan tilts them out from a corner, cascade offsets them diagonally, deck stacks them upward and pile scatters them like loose photos.

table.name: visible
table.description: How many cards show, counting the top one. The rest wait hidden at the back.

table.name: spread
table.description: How far the cards behind fan, offset or scatter, from 0 for a neat stack to 1 for a wide one.

table.name: depth
table.description: How much smaller and darker each card behind gets, from 0 for none to 1 for a strong recede.

table.name: radius
table.description: Corner radius of the cards in pixels.

table.name: frame
table.description: Width of a border around each card in pixels, like the edge of a printed photo.

table.name: frameColor
table.description: Color of the frame around each card.

table.name: shadow
table.description: Gives every card a soft drop shadow.

table.name: tilt
table.description: How far the top card leans in 3D while it is dragged, in degrees. It tilts around the point you hold and leans into fast moves. Use 0 to keep it flat.

table.name: threshold
table.description: How far in pixels the top card has to be dragged before it goes to the back. A quick flick works too.

table.name: speed
table.description: Speed of every animation, from 0.5 for slow and soft to 2 for fast and snappy.

table.name: sendToBackOnClick
table.description: Clicking the top card also sends it to the back.

table.name: autoplay
table.description: Cycles through the cards on its own.

table.name: autoplayDelay
table.description: Time in milliseconds between automatic cycles.

table.name: pauseOnHover
table.description: Pauses autoplay while the pointer is over the stack.

table.name: onChange
table.description: Called with the index of the new top card whenever the stack moves.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the root element.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the root element.

name: Stepper
description: A multi-step flow with a gliding step indicator, spring transitions and horizontal or vertical layouts.

table.name: children
table.description: The steps. Wrap each one in Step, which can also take a title, description and icon.

table.name: Step title
table.description: Label shown under the indicator, or beside it in the vertical layout.

table.name: Step description
table.description: Second line shown beside the indicator in the vertical layout.

table.name: Step icon
table.description: Icon shown inside the indicator instead of the number.

table.name: step
table.description: Controls the current step yourself. Use it with onStepChange.

table.name: initialStep
table.description: The step shown first.

table.name: onStepChange
table.description: Called when the step changes.

table.name: onFinalStepCompleted
table.description: Called when the last step is completed.

table.name: indicator
table.description: Style of the step indicators in the horizontal layout.

table.name: orientation
table.description: Indicators across the top, or a rail of numbered steps beside the content.

table.name: transition
table.description: How the content changes between steps. The height always animates.

table.name: linear
table.description: Only lets the indicators jump back to steps that have been reached.

table.name: disableStepIndicators
table.description: Stops the indicators from changing the step when clicked.

table.name: renderStepIndicator
table.description: Renders your own numbered indicator.

table.name: showFooter
table.description: Shows the Back and Continue buttons.

table.name: backButtonText
table.description: Text of the Back button.

table.name: nextButtonText
table.description: Text of the Continue button.

table.name: completeButtonText
table.description: Text of the Continue button on the last step.

table.name: backButtonProps
table.description: Extra props for the Back button.

table.name: nextButtonProps
table.description: Extra props for the Continue button, such as disabled while a step is incomplete.

table.name: completedContent
table.description: Shown in place of the steps once the last one is completed.

table.name: theme
table.description: Color theme of the panel and controls.

table.name: accentColor
table.description: Color of completed steps, the progress lines and the Continue button.

table.name: frame
table.description: Shows the frosted panel around the stepper.

table.name: radius
table.description: Corner radius of the panel, in px.

table.name: width
table.description: Maximum width of the stepper.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the stepper.

table.name: stepContainerClassName
table.description: Extra class names for the indicator row.

table.name: contentClassName
table.description: Extra class names for the content area.

table.name: footerClassName
table.description: Extra class names for the footer.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the stepper.

name: TiltedCard
description: A 3D card that tilts toward the cursor, with glare, a soft shadow, floating layers and a flip side.

table.name: imageSrc
table.description: Photo that fills the card.

table.name: altText
table.description: Alternative text for the photo.

table.name: children
table.description: Content on the face of the card, over the photo or instead of it.

table.name: captionText
table.description: Text in the small tag that follows the cursor and swings as it moves.

table.name: showTooltip
table.description: Shows the caption tag on hover.

table.name: overlayContent
table.description: Content that floats in front of the card, lifted off its surface.

table.name: displayOverlayContent
table.description: Shows the overlay content.

table.name: overlayDepth
table.description: How far the overlay floats in front, in px.

table.name: backContent
table.description: Content for the back of the card. Clicking, tapping or pressing Enter flips the card over.

table.name: flipOnClick
table.description: Flips the card when it is clicked. Needs backContent.

table.name: flipped
table.description: Controls which side shows. Leave it unset to let clicks flip the card.

table.name: onFlip
table.description: Called with the new side whenever the card is flipped.

table.name: onClick
table.description: Called when the card is clicked or activated with the keyboard.

table.name: containerWidth
table.description: Width of the area that reacts to the cursor.

table.name: containerHeight
table.description: Height of the area that reacts to the cursor.

table.name: imageWidth
table.description: Width of the card.

table.name: imageHeight
table.description: Height of the card.

table.name: rotateAmplitude
table.description: How far the card tilts toward the cursor, in degrees.

table.name: scaleOnHover
table.description: How much the card grows when hovered.

table.name: perspective
table.description: Viewing distance in px. Lower values give a stronger 3D effect.

table.name: radius
table.description: Corner radius of the card.

table.name: smoothness
table.description: From 0 to 1. Low values snap to the cursor, high values glide and settle with a soft bounce.

table.name: glare
table.description: Strength of the light that catches the surface and edges as the card tilts, from 0 to 1.

table.name: glareColor
table.description: Color of the glare.

table.name: shadow
table.description: Strength of the soft shadow under the card, which shifts and grows as the card lifts, from 0 to 1.

table.name: parallax
table.description: How far layers and the photo shift with the tilt. 0 keeps everything flat.

table.name: axis
table.description: Limits the tilt to following the cursor left and right, or up and down.

table.name: reverse
table.description: Tilts away from the cursor instead of toward it.

table.name: trackWindow
table.description: The card follows the cursor anywhere on the page, not only while hovered.

table.name: floating
table.description: The card drifts and sways gently while idle.

table.name: gyroscope
table.description: Tilts the card as a phone or tablet is moved. Asks for permission on iOS on the first tap.

table.name: intro
table.description: The card rises and settles into place when it first scrolls into view.

table.name: introDelay
table.description: Wait before the intro, in ms. Stagger it across a row of cards.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the card.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the card.

table.name: TiltedCardLayer
table.description: Wrap content in <TiltedCardLayer depth={30}> to float it above the card face. Higher depth floats further, negative depth sinks behind.

backContent.$jsx: The back of the card

name: StaggeredMenu
description: Menu with staggered item animations and smooth transitions on open/close.

table.name: position
table.description: Anchor position for the menu panel (left or right side).

table.name: colors
table.description: Colors used for staggered underlay layers.

table.name: items
table.description: Menu items rendered inside the panel.

table.name: socialItems
table.description: Social links displayed in the menu panel.

table.name: displaySocials
table.description: Whether to display the social links section.

table.name: displayItemNumbering
table.description: Whether to show numbering for menu items.

table.name: className
table.description: Optional extra class names.

table.name: logoUrl
table.description: Path to the logo image.

table.name: menuButtonColor
table.description: Color of the menu toggle button when closed.

table.name: openMenuButtonColor
table.description: Color of the menu toggle button when open.

table.name: accentColor
table.description: Hover accent color for menu items.

table.name: changeMenuColorOnOpen
table.description: Whether to animate the button color when opening/closing.

table.name: onMenuOpen
table.description: Callback function called when menu opens.

table.name: onMenuClose
table.description: Callback function called when menu closes.

table.name: closeOnClickAway
table.description: Whether to close the menu when clicking outside.

name: ReflectiveCard
description: A metal ID card that reflects your camera or a looping video and catches the light as it tilts.

table.name: name
table.description: Name shown on the card.

table.name: role
table.description: Role shown under the name.

table.name: badge
table.description: Label of the badge in the top left corner.

table.name: status
table.description: Label of the status chip in the top right corner.

table.name: statusColor
table.description: Color of the status dot.

table.name: idLabel
table.description: Small label above the ID number.

table.name: idValue
table.description: ID number shown in the footer.

table.name: children
table.description: Custom content for the card. Replaces the badge, name and footer.

table.name: theme
table.description: Dark graphite or light silver metal, with matching text.

table.name: videoSrc
table.description: Looping video the card reflects when the camera is off. Without one it reflects a soft studio.

table.name: webcam
table.description: Reflects the camera feed, mirrored. Asks for camera access and falls back to the video.

table.name: onWebcamError
table.description: Called when camera access is denied or unavailable.

table.name: tint
table.description: Color of the metal. White gives plain steel.

table.name: metalness
table.description: How strongly the surface mirrors the scene, from 0 to 1. At 0 the card turns matte.

table.name: roughness
table.description: Brushed grain of the metal, from 0 to 1. Stretches reflections along the grain.

table.name: blurStrength
table.description: Blur of the reflection, in px.

table.name: grayscale
table.description: Removes color from the reflection, from 0 to 1. Lower it to see the scene in color.

table.name: warp
table.description: Gentle bends in the surface that ripple the reflection.

table.name: warpScale
table.description: Size of the bends.

table.name: shine
table.description: Brightness of the light band that sweeps across the card as it tilts.

table.name: bevel
table.description: Width of the polished edge that catches the light, in px.

table.name: glare
table.description: Strength of the light that follows the cursor, from 0 to 1.

table.name: enableTilt
table.description: Tilts the card toward the cursor.

table.name: tiltStrength
table.description: Largest tilt angle, in degrees.

table.name: intro
table.description: Fades the card in and sweeps the light across it once.

table.name: width
table.description: Width of the card. Numbers are in px.

table.name: height
table.description: Height of the card. Numbers are in px.

table.name: radius
table.description: Corner radius, in px.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the card.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the card.

onWebcamError: new Error('Camera access is not available in this browser.')

name: PatternWaves
description: A lit halftone surface of dots, lines or glyphs that moves like draped silk.

table.name: preset
table.description: A complete starting look. Every pattern, wave and light prop below overrides the preset value when you pass it.

table.name: pattern
table.description: The mark that draws the surface. Line traces it as flowing contour lines, glyph uses characters picked by brightness.

table.name: wave
table.description: The shape of the moving surface. Silk is draped fabric folds, swell is rolling parallel waves, ripple is rings travelling in from off screen.

table.name: color
table.description: The one color of the pattern. Shadows, midtones and highlights are all derived from it. A color darker than the background prints like ink.

table.name: backgroundColor
table.description: Color behind the pattern. Pass transparent to show the page through.

table.name: spacing
table.description: Distance between marks in CSS pixels. Smaller values give a finer print.

table.name: markSize
table.description: Largest mark as a fraction of the spacing.

table.name: depth
table.description: How tall the surface is. Deeper surfaces cast stronger shading and lift the marks along the crests.

table.name: light
table.description: Angle of the light across the waves in degrees, from -90 to 90. 0 lights the folds head on, larger values graze them.

table.name: shine
table.description: Strength of the glints where the surface catches the light.

table.name: contrast
table.description: Spread between the quiet shadows and the lit areas.

table.name: speed
table.description: How fast the surface moves. 0 freezes it while the cursor keeps working.

table.name: scale
table.description: Size of the waves. Larger values give broader, calmer forms.

table.name: direction
table.description: Direction the waves travel in degrees. The light turns with it.

table.name: opacity
table.description: Overall opacity of the pattern, from 0 to 1.

table.name: fade
table.description: Where the pattern fades into the background. Center keeps the middle calm for a headline, bottom and top fade towards that edge.

table.name: fadeSize
table.description: How far the fade reaches, from 0.05 to 1.

table.name: characters
table.description: Characters for the glyph pattern, ordered from the lightest to the densest.

table.name: interactive
table.description: Lets the cursor disturb the surface. Moving it leaves a wake of ripples that catch the light, a click drops a splash.

table.name: cursorSize
table.description: Radius of the patch of surface the cursor pushes, in CSS pixels.

table.name: cursorStrength
table.description: How hard the cursor pushes the surface, from 0 to 1.

table.name: intro
table.description: On mount the marks fade in from the center, then the surface rises and the light sweeps across it.

table.name: paused
table.description: Freezes the surface. The cursor ripples keep working.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the root element.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the root element.

name: MicroSlats
description: A wall of tiny slats that becomes a rolling sea in perspective, with glinting crests.

table.name: preset
table.description: A starting look for the sea. Every wave prop below overrides the preset value when you pass it. Signal turns the field into a flat, equalizer style wall.

table.name: color
table.description: Color of the slats.

table.name: glintColor
table.description: Color the slats shift towards on wave crests and in the light the cursor leaves.

table.name: backgroundColor
table.description: Color behind the slats. Pass transparent to show the page through.

table.name: slatWidth
table.description: Width of one slat in CSS pixels.

table.name: slatHeight
table.description: Full height of one slat in CSS pixels.

table.name: gap
table.description: Space between slats in CSS pixels.

table.name: roundness
table.description: Corner rounding of each slat, from square at 0 to a full pill at 1.

table.name: scale
table.description: Size of the swell. Larger values give longer, calmer waves.

table.name: speed
table.description: How fast the waves roll. 0 freezes the sea while the cursor can still stir it.

table.name: direction
table.description: Heading of the swell in degrees. 270 rolls straight towards the viewer.

table.name: chop
table.description: Sharpens the crests and flattens the troughs, like wind on the water.

table.name: stretch
table.description: How much each slat grows and shrinks with the wave under it. 0 keeps every slat full length.

table.name: glint
table.description: Strength of the light caught on the crests.

table.name: contrast
table.description: Spread between dark troughs and bright crests.

table.name: perspective
table.description: How far the sea recedes towards a horizon above the top edge. 0 is a flat wall.

table.name: fog
table.description: Haze that fades the far rows into the background.

table.name: interactive
table.description: Lets the cursor stir the water. Moving it pushes a real fluid that bends the swell and carries a swirling trail of light, and a click spins out a splash.

table.name: cursorStrength
table.description: Brightness of the light the cursor leaves in the water.

table.name: cursorSize
table.description: Radius of the patch of water the cursor pushes, in CSS pixels.

table.name: swirl
table.description: How strongly the stirred water curls into eddies.

table.name: trail
table.description: How long the stirred water and its light linger, in seconds.

table.name: lean
table.description: How far the slats tilt with the current. 0 keeps them upright.

table.name: intro
table.description: Rolls the sea in from the horizon on mount, unfolding the slats row by row.

table.name: introDuration
table.description: Length of the intro in seconds.

table.name: paused
table.description: Freezes the waves. The cursor can still stir the water.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the root element.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the root element.

name: ShapeWaves
description: A field of triangles, circles and squares that brighten and grow along rolling waves.

table.name: text
table.description: Optional text carved out of the field. Cells under the glyphs stay empty and the waves flow around them.

table.name: fontFamily
table.description: CSS font family used to draw the text cutout.

table.name: fontWeight
table.description: Font weight of the text cutout.

table.name: textSize
table.description: Text height as a fraction of the container height. Long text shrinks to fit the width.

table.name: shapes
table.description: 'mixed' draws dark bands as triangles, mid bands as circles and bright bands as squares. 'squares', 'circles' or 'triangles' use one glyph and vary its size per band instead.

table.name: cellSize
table.description: Size of one grid cell in CSS pixels.

table.name: dotSize
table.description: Glyph size as a fraction of the cell.

table.name: color
table.description: Glyph color. One flat color for the whole field.

table.name: hoverColor
table.description: Color the glyphs step towards inside a splash.

table.name: backgroundColor
table.description: Background color behind the glyphs.

table.name: speed
table.description: How fast the wave bands morph over time. 0 freezes them.

table.name: scale
table.description: Size of the wave bands. Larger values give broader, calmer swells.

table.name: contrast
table.description: How sharply the field is cut into its three bands.

table.name: brightness
table.description: Shifts the balance between dark, mid and bright bands.

table.name: flow
table.description: Drift speed of the field in cells per second. 0 evolves in place.

table.name: direction
table.description: Drift direction in degrees, used when flow is above 0.

table.name: fade
table.description: Strength of the radial fade into the background towards the edges. 0 disables it.

table.name: interactive
table.description: Lets the cursor splash into the field, sending ripples that cycle the glyphs and light them up.

table.name: splashRadius
table.description: Size of a cursor splash in CSS pixels.

table.name: splashStrength
table.description: How much energy a splash drops in. Higher values throw wider, brighter ripples.

table.name: glow
table.description: Bloom on lit glyphs. 0 disables the glow pass entirely.

table.name: intro
table.description: Plays a spawn animation on mount: the shapes pop in along a wave that travels from the centre to the corners.

table.name: introDuration
table.description: Length of the intro wave in seconds.

table.name: introKey
table.description: Change this value to replay the intro wave without remounting.

table.name: paused
table.description: Freezes the wave motion. Splashes keep working.

table.name: onError
table.description: Called when WebGPU is unavailable or rendering fails. The background color still shows.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the root element.

onError: error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error))

name: AeroShards
description: Silk ribbons of thick glass shards streaming on layered depths among survey markers, catching light along their edges.

table.name: shardColor
table.description: Main color of the shards.

table.name: accentColor
table.description: Color of the light the shards catch, their rim light and the markers.

table.name: backgroundColor
table.description: Fills the canvas behind the shards. Transparent lets the page show through.

table.name: lightMode
table.description: Draws the shards as soft tinted glass for light backgrounds.

table.name: placement
table.description: Where the ribbons flow: across the whole view, down one side, or in a ring around the center.

table.name: material
table.description: Surface of the shards: thick glass that catches light along its edges, or polished chrome.

table.name: markers
table.description: Survey markers floating at each depth. A few blink, and the one nearest the cursor gets a target frame.

table.name: count
table.description: Number of shards across all the ribbons.

table.name: shardSize
table.description: Size of the shards.

table.name: spread
table.description: Width of the ribbons.

table.name: twist
table.description: How much the ribbons twist along their length.

table.name: billow
table.description: How much the ribbons ripple like silk.

table.name: speed
table.description: How fast the shards flow.

table.name: scale
table.description: Zoom of the whole scene.

table.name: depthOfField
table.description: How soft the farther ribbons get. 0 keeps everything sharp.

table.name: glow
table.description: Soft bloom around the brightest glints.

table.name: grain
table.description: Film grain on the shards. 0 turns it off.

table.name: vignette
table.description: Fades everything out toward the edges of the frame. 0 runs edge to edge.

table.name: intro
table.description: The ribbons draw in from the left, front to back, on mount.

table.name: mouseInteraction
table.description: The cursor parts the shards it passes through and leans the camera toward it.

table.name: mouseStrength
table.description: How strongly the cursor parts the shards.

table.name: parallax
table.description: How far the camera leans toward the cursor.

table.name: pulseOnClick
table.description: Clicking sends a ring of light out through every depth, flipping the shards it passes.

table.name: holdToGather
table.description: Pressing and holding gathers nearby shards into a swirl that scatters back on release.

table.name: paused
table.description: Freezes the flow.

table.name: dpr
table.description: Maximum device pixel ratio of the canvas.

table.name: onError
table.description: Called if WebGPU is unavailable or fails, so you can show a fallback.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra class names for the container.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the container.

onError: error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error))

name: GhostFibers
description: Layered ribbons of fine glowing fibers that twist, fold and drift through soft depth of field.

table.name: glowColor
table.description: Main color of the fibers.

table.name: lineColor
table.description: Color of the bright folds, sparkles and tips. Leave it out to use a pale tint of the glow color.

table.name: secondaryColor

name: FolderFloat
description: Folder whose notes spring out into a floating cloud when it opens on hover or press.

table.name: items
table.description: The pills that float out. A string is its own value.

table.name: label
table.description: The line on the flap.

table.name: sublabel
table.description: The dimmer line under it. Empty counts the notes.

table.description: Open on hover, or toggle on press.

table.name: defaultOpen

table.name: closeOnSelect
table.description: Picking a pill closes the folder.

table.name: physics
table.description: Once the pills land, a zero-gravity world takes over: they float, collide, and can be dragged and thrown inside the cloud.

table.name: drift
table.description: Strength of the floating currents in the world. 0 holds still.

table.name: onSelect
table.description: A pill was picked.

table.name: onOpenChange
table.description: The folder opened or closed.

table.name: folderColor

table.description: The pills.

table.description: The pill text.

table.description: Folder height in px, below the tab.

name: BranchedMenu
description: Collapsible menu that branches each section from a trunk and traces a line to your pick.

table.name: items
table.description: Sections: label plus children (value, label, icon), or a leaf with a value. A section with children folds; a leaf selects.

table.name: defaultOpen
table.description: The section, or sections, open at first. -1 for none.

table.name: defaultActive
table.description: Value selected at first. Empty picks the open section's first child.

table.name: onSelect
table.description: A child or a leaf was picked.

table.name: onToggle
table.description: A section folded or unfolded.

table.name: color
table.description: The ink. Lines and idle text are mixes of it.

table.name: accentColor
table.description: The active line, the active label and the marker.

table.name: lineColor
table.description: The rail, trunk and branches. A solid colour, so joints never darken.

table.name: width
table.description: The widest the menu may be, in px. It shrinks to its content.

table.name: rowHeight
table.description: Height of a child row in px.

table.name: indent
table.description: Where child rows start, in px. Branches end just before it.

table.name: trunk
table.description: The trunk line's x position, in px.

table.name: radius
table.description: The curve of each branch, in px.

table.name: lineWidth
table.description: Stroke width of the lines.

table.name: fontSize
table.description: Child text size in px. Headers are 1px larger.

table.name: drawDuration

name: FlipCard
description: Two-faced card that flips in 3D on a click, drag or flick and settles on a spring.

table.name: front
table.description: Content of the front face.

table.name: back
table.description: Content of the back face.

table.name: flipped
table.description: Controlled state: true shows the back. Omit it to let the card manage itself.

table.name: defaultFlipped
table.description: Start on the back face.

table.name: onFlipChange
table.description: Fires when a click, drag, flick or key lands on the other face.

table.name: axis
table.description: y turns the card sideways and drags horizontally. x turns it over the top and drags vertically.

table.name: flipOnClick
table.description: A press without movement flips the card.

table.name: draggable
table.description: Drag to turn the card by hand. On release it springs to the nearest face, carrying the flick velocity.

table.name: dragDistance
table.description: Pixels of drag for a half turn. 0 uses the card width, or its height on the x axis.

table.name: tilt
table.description: The card leans toward the cursor on hover.

table.name: tiltMax
table.description: Largest tilt angle in degrees.

table.name: glare
table.description: A soft sheen that follows the cursor.

table.name: glareOpacity
table.description: Strength of the sheen at its centre.

table.name: hoverScale
table.description: Lift while hovered or held.

table.name: perspective
table.description: Viewing distance in px. Smaller is more dramatic.

table.name: stiffness
table.description: Stiffness of the flip spring.

table.name: damping
table.description: Damping of the flip spring. Lower overshoots more.

table.name: width
table.description: Card width in px, capped at the parent.

table.name: height
table.description: Card height in px.

table.name: radius

table.name: background

table.name: color
table.description: Text colour of both faces.

table.name: shadow

table.name: shadowColor
table.description: Shadow colour.

table.name: shadowOpacity
table.description: Shadow strength.

table.name: disabled

name: TearTicket
description: Ticket whose perforated stub tears off by hand, fibre by fibre, and drops away.

table.name: children
table.description: Content of the ticket body.

table.name: stub
table.description: Content of the tear-off stub.

table.name: image
table.description: Artwork behind the body. It shifts against the tilt for parallax and turns grey once used.

table.name: imageAlt
table.description: Alt text for the artwork.

table.name: scrim
table.description: A fade from the paper colour up over the artwork, so text stays readable on busy images.

table.name: imageRadius
table.description: Corner radius of the artwork panel, in px. Set it to the ticket radius minus 8 to stay concentric.

table.name: orientation
table.description: Horizontal puts the stub on the right. Vertical puts the artwork on top and the stub at the bottom.

table.name: torn
table.description: Controlled state. Set it back to false to restore the stub.

table.name: defaultTorn
table.description: Start already used.

table.name: onTear
table.description: Fires once the stub has come free and gone.

table.name: width
table.description: Ticket width in px. It scales down to fit a narrower parent.

table.name: height
table.description: Ticket height in px.

table.name: stubSize
table.description: Size of the stub along the ticket, in px: its width when horizontal, its height when vertical.

table.name: radius
table.description: Outer corner radius in px.

table.name: holes
table.description: Perforation holes along the tear line.

table.name: holeSize
table.description: Hole diameter in px.

table.name: notch
table.description: Radius of the notches at both ends of the tear line.

table.name: roughness
table.description: Optional jitter of the torn line between holes, in px. 0 keeps the edge perfectly straight and symmetrical.

table.name: tearAngle
table.description: Degrees of pull at which the last bridge gives way and the stub comes free.

table.name: stretch
table.description: How far a paper bridge stretches before it snaps, in px. Bridges far from the hinge reach it first.

table.name: resistance
table.description: How much the intact fibres hold the stub back, 0 to 1. The pull eases as bridges give way, so the paper fights hardest at the start.

table.name: rotate
table.description: A resting tilt of the whole ticket in the page plane, in degrees.

table.name: tilt
table.description: The ticket leans toward the cursor in 3D.

table.name: tiltMax
table.description: Largest tilt angle in degrees.

table.name: tiltReach
table.description: How far beyond the ticket the pointer still steers the tilt, in px. The tilt tracks the whole page.

table.name: parallax
table.description: How far the artwork travels against the tilt, in px.

table.name: perspective
table.description: Viewing distance in px.

table.name: background
table.description: Paper colour, also used by the fibres.

table.name: color
table.description: Text colour.

table.name: border
table.description: A hairline drawn along the cut edge of each piece, following every hole and notch.

table.name: borderColor
table.description: Colour of that hairline. Empty derives a faint tint of the text colour.

table.name: borderWidth
table.description: Thickness of the hairline in px.

table.name: stubBackground
table.description: Stub paper colour. Empty follows background.

table.name: recenter
table.description: Once the stub is gone, the remaining ticket glides over to sit centred in its original box.

table.name: disabled
table.description: Dimmed and inert.

table.name: ariaLabel
table.description: Accessible name of the stub. Enter or Space tears it.

table.description: Extra classes for the root.

name: PaperCrumple
description: An image that crumples into a textured 3D sheet while you hold and drag it.

table.name: src
table.description: Required image URL. PNG transparency is preserved. Remote image servers must allow CORS.

table.name: alt
table.description: Image description used by the fallback and the accessible hold control.

table.name: backSrc
table.description: Optional image printed on the reverse. Otherwise the back uses paperColor.

table.name: width
table.description: Unfolded paper width in pixels. Scales down to fit the stage with a 24px inset.

table.name: height
table.description: Unfolded paper height in pixels. Determines the sheet aspect ratio.

table.name: sceneHeight
table.description: Height of the full-width stage in pixels, including space to drag.

table.name: imageFit
table.description: Cover crops the texture; contain keeps the entire image and leaves unused space transparent.

table.name: releaseBehavior
table.description: Freeze the current crumple, unfold completely, or unfold with lasting crease relief.

table.name: crumpleAmount
table.description: Maximum fold amount while held, from 0 (flat) to 1 (fully crumpled).

table.name: crumpleDuration
table.description: Approximate settling time in seconds while holding. 0 makes the change immediate.

table.name: releaseDuration
table.description: Approximate unfolding time in seconds. Another press can interrupt it.

table.name: foldCount
table.description: Number of crease guides in the paper solver, from 3 to 16. Each seed produces a different arrangement.

table.name: foldSharpness
table.description: Blend from rounded wrinkles (0) to angular creases (1).

table.name: wrinkleDepth
table.description: Compression depth, from 0 to 2. Higher values produce a tighter wad and stronger residual folds.

table.name: creaseStrength
table.description: Residual relief from 0 to 1 for the creased release mode. Longer holds leave stronger creases.

table.name: paperColor
table.description: Color of the unprinted back of the sheet.

table.name: roughness
table.description: Material roughness, from smooth (0) to matte (1).

table.name: paperTexture
table.description: Fine paper-grain bump strength, from 0 to 1.

table.name: lightIntensity
table.description: Strength of the directional light that reveals folds.

table.name: lightAngle
table.description: Direction of the key light in degrees. 0 shines from above.

table.name: shadow
table.description: Enable self-shadowing and a soft drop shadow behind the paper.

table.name: shadowOpacity
table.description: Opacity of the cast and drop shadows, from 0 to 1.

table.name: draggable
table.description: Move the sheet while held. The grabbed material point follows the pointer.

table.name: dragRotation
table.description: Maximum tilt in degrees while dragging. 0 disables tilt.

table.name: dragRadius
table.description: Maximum resting offset on each axis, in pixels. The stage also bounds the resting position.

table.name: returnToOrigin
table.description: Restore and creased modes return to the center. Stay mode leaves the paper where it was dropped.

table.name: rotation
table.description: Initial sheet rotation in degrees.

table.name: seed
table.description: Seed for a repeatable arrangement of folds and paper grain.

table.name: detail
table.description: Simulation detail, clamped to 32–96. Higher values add smaller folds and take longer to prepare.

table.name: disabled
table.description: Disable pointer and keyboard input and finish any active hold.

table.name: resetKey
table.description: Change this value to reset the position, crumple and accumulated creases immediately.

table.name: onStateChange
table.description: Reports holding, then the selected release state: flat, crumpled or creased.

table.name: onError
table.description: Called if WebGL initialization or image loading fails. The original image remains as a fallback.

table.name: className
table.description: Additional classes for the stage.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the stage, including a background or custom height.

name: Shredder
description: A list with a paper shredder at the bottom that cuts dragged rows into curling strips.

table.name: items
table.description: Rows to render, top to bottom. Each item needs a unique id.

table.name: renderItem
table.description: Renders one row. A snapshot of the rendered row is what gets cut into strips, so plain markup, inline images and inline SVG all work.

table.name: onShred
table.description: Called the moment a row has gone through the rollers. Remove the item from your list here, unless loop, loopAfterDelete or autoAnimate is on.

table.name: onReorder
table.description: Called with the items in their new order after a row is dropped somewhere else in the list.

table.name: width
table.description: Width of the whole machine in pixels.

table.name: height
table.description: Total height. The rows stack up from the slit, which sits above the fall zone at the bottom.

table.name: inset
table.description: Horizontal inset of the rows from the edges. The slit is 6px wider than the rows on each side.

table.name: gap
table.description: Space between rows in pixels.

table.name: slitHeight
table.description: Thickness of the slit. It is always a full pill.

table.name: fallHeight
table.description: Height of the zone under the slit where the strips fall and fade out.

table.name: feedSpeed
table.description: Roller speed in pixels per second. The first pull is faster and eases into it.

table.name: bite
table.description: How far a row has to be pushed into the slit before the rollers grab it, in pixels.

table.name: autoFeed
table.description: Grab the row as soon as it is pushed in far enough, even while it is still held. Off, it feeds only on release over the slit.

table.name: stripWidth
table.description: Target width of each strip in pixels. The row is cut into equal columns.

table.name: curl
table.description: How much the strips curl and wave as they come out. 0 keeps them straight.

table.name: autoAnimate
table.description: Plays through the rows on its own, bottom to top, then brings them back and starts over. Keep the rows in your list while it runs; onShred still fires.

table.name: loop
table.description: Once the last row has been shredded, bring them all back. Keep the rows in your list while it is on.

table.name: loopAfterDelete
table.description: After a row is shredded it comes back a moment later at a random spot, so the list never runs dry. Keep the rows in your list while it is on.

table.name: dragTilt
table.description: Maximum lean in degrees while a row is dragged sideways.

table.name: lift
table.description: Scale of a row while it is held.

table.name: slitColor
table.description: Colour of the slit.

table.name: color
table.description: Text colour inherited by the rows.

table.name: disabled
table.description: Rows cannot be dragged or shredded.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra classes for the root.

name: FlyingButton
description: Button that fires its thrusters on hover, lifts off on a WebGL smoke plume and lands back in its own cloud.

table.name: children
table.description: The button label.

table.name: onClick
table.description: Called on click, including clicks while it is in the air. Dragging the flying button moves it instead, and it lands wherever you let go.

table.name: theme
table.description: Shades the smoke for a dark or a light page and picks the matching default colours.

table.name: size
table.description: Button size. The pods, jets, flames and smoke scale with it.

table.name: radius
table.description: Corner radius in pixels. Fully rounded when unset.

table.name: altitude
table.description: How high the button climbs, in pixels. Capped by the container height.

table.name: hoverTime
table.description: Seconds it hovers at altitude before it comes back down and lands.

table.name: jets
table.description: Number of exhaust jets under the button, from 1 to 4.

table.name: thrusters
table.description: Shows thruster pods under the button. Off, the jets fire straight out of its underside.

table.name: trigger
table.description: Whether hovering or clicking starts the flight. Touch always starts it on tap. With the ramp on, a click starts the ride instead.

table.name: carryCursor
table.description: Carries the cursor up with the button while you hover it, and sets it back down on landing.

table.name: smoke
table.description: How much smoke the jets and the ground blast put out.

table.name: turbulence
table.description: How much the smoke curls and billows.

table.name: wobble
table.description: Strength of the gusts the flight controller fights while it hovers. 0 flies dead steady.

table.name: ramp
table.description: Adds a loop ramp on the right. A click drives the button up the wall and along the ceiling, then it flips off the end, lands and rolls back.

table.name: thrustColor
table.description: Colour of the jet flames and the light they cast. Defaults to a pale blue for the theme.

table.name: smokeColor
table.description: Base colour of the smoke. Its shadows are derived from it.

table.name: buttonColor
table.description: Button fill. Defaults to dark grey on dark pages and near black on light ones.

table.name: textColor
table.description: Label colour.

table.name: rampColor
table.description: Ramp colour. Defaults to a raised surface for the theme.

table.name: className
table.description: Extra classes for the root.

table.name: style
table.description: Inline styles for the root.
